articles.title_en: Sieve BLP: A semi-nonparametric model of demand for differentiated products
articles.title_cn: 筛子BLP：差异化产品需求的半非参数模型
articles.abstract_en: We develop a semi-nonparametric approach to identify and estimate the demand for differentiated products. The proposed method adopts a random coefficients discrete choice logit model (i.e., mixed logit model) in which the distribution of random coefficients is nonparametrically specified. Our method minimizes misspecification error in the distribution to which routinely used parametric approach is subject. In addition, it overcomes the practical challenge of dimensionality in the number of products that remains the main hurdle in the nonparametric estimation of demand functions. We propose a sieve estimation procedure (referred to as sieve BLP) that remains simple to implement. Extensive Monte Carlo simulations show its robust finite-sample performance under various data generating processes. We use the method to investigate the welfare implications of a sugar tax in the ready-to-eat cereal industry in the US. This application underscores the usefulness of sieve BLP due to its ability to allow for flexibly specified individual heterogeneity in demand, especially when the researcher aims to quantify the distributional effects of a policy change.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一种半非参数方法来识别和估计差异化产品的需求。所提出的方法采用随机系数离散选择logit模型（即混合logit模型），其中随机系数的分布是非参数指定的。我们的方法最小化了常规参数方法所面临的分布误设误差。此外，它克服了产品数量维度上的实际挑战，这一挑战仍然是需求函数非参数估计的主要障碍。我们提出了一种筛子估计程序（称为筛子BLP），该程序实施简单。广泛的蒙特卡洛模拟显示了其在各种数据生成过程下的稳健有限样本性能。我们使用该方法研究美国即食麦片行业中糖税对福利的影响。这一应用强调了筛子BLP的实用性，因为它能够灵活地指定需求中的个体异质性，特别是当研究者旨在量化政策变化的分配效应时。

articles.title_en: Testing for time stochastic dominance
articles.title_cn: 时间随机占优的检验
articles.abstract_en: We propose nonparametric tests for the null hypothesis of time stochastic dominance. Time stochastic dominance makes a partial order of different prospects over time based on the net present value criteria for general utility and time discount function classes. For example, time stochastic dominance can be used for ranking investment strategies or environmental policies based on the expected net present value of the future benefits. We consider an L p -type test statistic and derive its large sample distribution under standard panel data sampling scheme with fixed time dimension. We suggest a path-wise (or cluster) bootstrap procedure that allows individual time series dependence over the time horizon. We describe two approaches, the contact-set approach and the numerical delta method, that may lead to enhanced power compared to the conventional least-favorable-case based approach. We prove the asymptotic validity of our testing procedures. We investigate the finite sample performance of the tests in simulation studies. As an illustration, we apply the proposed tests to evaluate the Million Baht Village Fund Program in Thailand and carbon emission trading scheme in China.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出针对时间随机占优原假设的非参数检验。时间随机占优基于一般效用和时间贴现函数类的净现值准则，对不同跨期前景进行部分排序。例如，时间随机占优可用于根据未来收益的期望净现值对投资策略或环境政策进行排序。我们考虑一种 L p 型检验统计量，并在固定时间维度的标准面板数据抽样方案下推导其大样本分布。我们提出一种路径式（或聚类）自助法程序，允许个体时间序列在时间跨度上存在相依性。我们描述两种方法，即接触集方法和数值 delta 方法，与传统的基于最不利情形的方法相比，这两种方法可能带来更高的功效。我们证明检验程序的渐近有效性。我们在模拟研究中考察检验的有限样本表现。作为示例，我们将所提出的检验应用于评估泰国的百万泰铢村庄基金项目和中国碳排放权交易体系。

articles.title_en: Theory of evolutionary spectra for heteroskedasticity and autocorrelation robust inference in possibly misspecified and nonstationary models
articles.title_cn: 关于可能误设和非平稳模型中异方差与自相关稳健推断的演化谱理论
articles.abstract_en: The literature on heteroskedasticity and autocorrelation robust (HAR) inference is extensive but its usefulness relies on stationarity of the relevant process, say V t , usually a function of the data and estimated model residuals. Yet, a large body of work shows widespread evidence of various forms of nonstationarity in the latter. Also, many testing problems are such that V t is stationary under the null hypothesis but nonstationary under the alternative. In either case, the consequences are possible size distortions and, especially, a reduction in power which can be substantial (e.g., non-monotonic power), since all such estimates are based on weighted sums of the sample autocovariances of V t , which are inflated. We propose HAR inference methods valid under a broad class of nonstationary processes, labeled Segmented Local Stationary, which possess a spectrum that varies both over frequencies and time. It is allowed to change either slowly and continuously and/or abruptly at some time points, thereby encompassing most nonstationary models used in applied work. We introduce a double kernel estimator (DK-HAC) that applies a smoothing over both lagged autocovariances and time. The optimal kernels and bandwidth sequences are derived under a mean-squared error criterion. The data-dependent bandwidths rely on the “plug-in” approach using approximating parametric models having time-varying parameters estimated with standard methods applied to local data. Our method yields tests with good size and power in finite-samples. In particular, the power gains are achieved without notable size distortions.
articles.abstract_cn: 关于异方差与自相关稳健（HAR）推断的文献十分广泛，但其有用性依赖于相关过程（例如 V t ，通常是数据和估计模型残差的函数）的平稳性。然而，大量研究表明，后者中普遍存在各种形式的非平稳性证据。此外，许多检验问题使得 V t 在原假设下是平稳的，但在备择假设下是非平稳的。在任一情况下，后果都可能是规模扭曲，尤其是功效的降低，这种降低可能相当大（例如非单调功效），因为所有这些估计都基于 V t 样本自协方差的加权和，而这些自协方差被放大了。我们提出在广泛一类非平稳过程下有效的 HAR 推断方法，称为分段局部平稳，其具有随频率和时间变化的谱。它被允许缓慢且连续地和/或在某些时间点突然变化，从而涵盖应用研究中使用的大多数非平稳模型。我们引入双重核估计量（DK-HAC），它对滞后自协方差和时间两者都施加平滑。最优核和带宽序列在均方误差准则下推导得出。数据依赖的带宽依赖于“插入”方法，使用具有时变参数的近似参数模型，这些参数通过对局部数据应用标准方法进行估计。我们的方法在有限样本中产生具有良好规模和功效的检验。特别地，功效增益是在没有显著规模扭曲的情况下实现的。

articles.title_en: Sharpe Ratio analysis in high dimensions: Residual-based nodewise regression in factor models
articles.title_cn: 高维中的夏普比率分析：因子模型中基于残差的节点回归
articles.abstract_en: We provide a new theory for nodewise regression when the residuals from a fitted factor model are used. We apply our results to the analysis of the consistency of Sharpe Ratio estimators when there are many assets in a portfolio. We allow for an increasing number of assets as well as time observations of the portfolio. Since the nodewise regression is not feasible due to the unknown nature of idiosyncratic errors, we provide a feasible-residual-based nodewise regression to estimate the precision matrix of errors which is consistent even when number of assets, p , exceeds the time span of the portfolio, n . In another new development, we also show that the precision matrix of returns can be estimated consistently, even with an increasing number of factors and p > n . We show that: (1) with p > n , the Sharpe Ratio estimators are consistent in global minimum-variance and mean–variance portfolios; and (2) with p > n , the maximum Sharpe Ratio estimator is consistent when the portfolio weights sum to one; and (3) with p < < n , the maximum-out-of-sample Sharpe Ratio estimator is consistent.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们为使用拟合因子模型残差时的节点回归提供了一种新理论。我们将结果应用于投资组合中存在许多资产时夏普比率估计量一致性的分析。我们允许资产数量以及投资组合的时间观测数不断增加。由于节点回归因特质误差的未知性质而不可行，我们提供了一种基于可行残差的节点回归来估计误差的精度矩阵，即使资产数量 p 超过投资组合的时间跨度 n，该估计也是一致的。在另一项新进展中，我们还表明，即使因子数量不断增加且 p > n，收益率的精度矩阵也可以被一致地估计。我们表明：(1) 当 p > n 时，夏普比率估计量在全局最小方差和均值–方差投资组合中是一致的；以及 (2) 当 p > n 时，当投资组合权重之和为一时，最大夏普比率估计量是一致的；以及 (3) 当 p < < n 时，最大样本外夏普比率估计量是一致的。

articles.title_en: Partial identification and inference in moment models with incomplete data
articles.title_cn: 不完全数据下矩模型的局部识别与推断
articles.abstract_en: In this paper, we develop asymptotically valid inference in moment equality models with incomplete data, where the sample information is insufficient to identify the joint distribution of all the variables in the model. Examples of such models include the selection-on-observables framework, the counterfactual distribution, and parametric regressions with incomplete data. In the first two examples, the parameter of interest includes the values of the distribution and quantile functions of the individual treatment effect and the correlation coefficient of the potential outcomes. We show that the parameter of interest satisfies a semiparametric moment equality model with both point identified nuisance parameters and a partially identified copula function. We construct an asymptotically valid confidence set for the parameter of interest taking account of shape restrictions on the copula function. The critical value is constructed via a multiplier bootstrap. A simulation study is conducted to illustrate the finite sample performance of our inference procedure.
articles.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们针对具有不完全数据的矩等式模型开发了渐近有效的推断，其中样本信息不足以识别模型中所有变量的联合分布。此类模型的例子包括基于可观测变量的选择框架、反事实分布以及具有不完全数据的参数回归。在前两个例子中，感兴趣的参数包括个体处理效应的分布函数和分位数函数的值以及潜在结果之间的相关系数。我们表明，感兴趣的参数满足一个半参数矩等式模型，其中既包含点识别的冗余参数，也包含部分识别的copula函数。我们构建了一个渐近有效的置信集，考虑了copula函数的形状限制。临界值通过乘子自助法构造。我们进行了模拟研究，以说明我们推断程序的有限样本性能。

articles.title_en: Distribution-invariant differential privacy
articles.title_cn: 分布不变的差分隐私
articles.abstract_en: Differential privacy is becoming one gold standard for protecting the privacy of publicly shared data. It has been widely used in social science, data science, public health, information technology, and the U.S. decennial census. Nevertheless, to guarantee differential privacy, existing methods may unavoidably alter the conclusion of original data analysis, as privatization often changes the sample distribution. This phenomenon is known as the trade-off between privacy protection and statistical accuracy. In this work, we mitigate this trade-off by developing a distribution-invariant privatization (DIP) method to reconcile both high statistical accuracy and strict differential privacy. As a result, any downstream statistical or machine learning task yields essentially the same conclusion as if one used the original data. Numerically, under the same strictness of privacy protection, DIP achieves superior statistical accuracy in in a wide range of simulation studies and real-world benchmarks.
articles.abstract_cn: 差分隐私正成为保护公开共享数据隐私的一个黄金标准。它已被广泛应用于社会科学、数据科学、公共卫生、信息技术以及美国十年一次的人口普查。然而，为了保证差分隐私，现有方法可能不可避免地改变原始数据分析的结论，因为私有化常常改变样本分布。这种现象被称为隐私保护与统计准确性之间的权衡。在这项工作中，我们通过开发一种分布不变的私有化（DIP）方法来缓解这种权衡，以兼顾高统计准确性和严格的差分隐私。因此，任何下游统计或机器学习任务都会得出与使用原始数据基本相同的结论。在数值上，在相同的隐私保护严格程度下，DIP在广泛的模拟研究和真实世界基准测试中实现了优越的统计准确性。

articles.title_en: Maximum pairwise-rank-likelihood-based inference for the semiparametric transformation model
articles.title_cn: 半参数转换模型基于最大成对秩似然的推断
articles.abstract_en: In this paper, we study the linear transformation model in a general setup. This model includes many important and popular models in statistics and econometrics as special cases. Although it has been studied for many years, the methods in the literature are based on kernel-smoothing techniques or make use of only the ranks of the responses in the estimation of the parametric components. The former approach needs a tuning parameter, which is not easily optimally specified in practice; and some of the latter may be computationally expensive. In this paper, we propose two methods: a pairwise rank likelihood method and an estimation-equation-based method motivated from the score function of this pairwise rank likelihood. We also explore the theoretical properties of the proposed estimators. Via extensive numerical studies, we demonstrate that our methods are appealing in that the estimators are not only robust to the distribution of the random errors but also lead to mean square errors that are in many cases comparable to or smaller than those of existing methods.
articles.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们研究了一般设定下的线性转换模型。该模型包含统计学和计量经济学中许多重要且流行的模型作为特例。尽管该模型已被研究多年，但文献中的方法要么基于核平滑技术，要么在估计参数分量时仅利用响应的秩。前者需要调整参数，而在实践中难以最优地指定；后者中的一些方法可能计算成本高昂。在本文中，我们提出了两种方法：成对秩似然方法和基于该成对秩似然得分函数的估计方程方法。我们还探讨了所提出估计量的理论性质。通过广泛的数值研究，我们证明了我们的方法具有吸引力，因为估计量不仅对随机误差的分布具有稳健性，而且在许多情况下产生的均方误差与现有方法相当或更小。

articles.title_en: GARCH density and functional forecasts
articles.title_cn: GARCH密度与函数预测
articles.abstract_en: This paper derives the analytic form of the multi-step ahead prediction density of a Gaussian GARCH(1,1) process with a possibly asymmetric news impact curve in the GJR class. These results can be applied when single-period returns are modeled as a GJR Gaussian GARCH(1,1) and interest lies in single-period returns at some future forecast horizon. The Gaussian density has been used in applications as an approximation to this as yet unknown prediction density; the analytic form derived here shows that this prediction density, while symmetric, can be far from Gaussian. This explicit form can be used to compute exact tail probabilities and functionals, such as the Value at Risk and the Expected Shortfall, to quantify expected future required risk capital for single-period returns. Finally, the paper shows how estimation uncertainty can be mapped onto uncertainty regions for any functional of this prediction distribution.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文推导了具有可能非对称新闻影响曲线（属于GJR类）的高斯GARCH(1,1)过程的多步前向预测密度的解析形式。当单期收益被建模为GJR高斯GARCH(1,1)且关注未来预测期内的单期收益时，这些结果可以应用。高斯密度在应用中已被用作这一尚未可知的预测密度的近似；本文推导的解析形式表明，该预测密度虽然对称，但可能远非高斯分布。这一显式形式可用于计算精确的尾部概率和函数，如风险价值和预期短缺，以量化单期收益的未来预期所需风险资本。最后，本文展示了如何将估计不确定性映射到该预测分布的任何函数的不确定区域上。

articles.title_en: Robust inference in first-price auctions: Overbidding as an identifying restriction
articles.title_cn: 第一价格拍卖中的稳健推断：过度出价作为识别限制
articles.abstract_en: Laboratory experiments find consistently that bidding in first-price auctions tends to be more aggressive than predicted by the risk-neutral Bayesian Nash Equilibrium (RNBNE) — a finding known as the overbidding puzzle. Several alternative models can explain the overbidding puzzle, but no canonical alternative to RNBNE has emerged. Instead of estimating a particular model of overbidding, we use the overbidding restriction itself for identification, which allows us to bound the valuation distribution and the seller’s revenue under counterfactual reserve prices in the spirit of Haile and Tamer (2003). These bounds are consistent with RNBNE and all models of overbidding, and the bounds remain valid even if there is unobserved heterogeneity in bidding strategies. We evaluate the validity of the bounds numerically and in experimental data.
articles.abstract_cn: 实验室实验一致发现，第一价格拍卖中的出价往往比风险中性贝叶斯纳什均衡（RNBNE）所预测的更具攻击性——这一发现被称为过度出价之谜。几种替代模型可以解释过度出价之谜，但尚未出现RNBNE的规范替代方案。我们不估计特定的过度出价模型，而是利用过度出价限制本身进行识别，从而在Haile和Tamer（2003）的精神下，对反事实保留价格下的估价分布和卖方收入进行界定。这些界限与RNBNE及所有过度出价模型一致，并且即使出价策略存在未观测的异质性，这些界限仍然有效。我们在数值上和实验数据中评估了这些界限的有效性。

articles.title_en: Testing stochastic dominance with many conditioning variables
articles.title_cn: 在存在多个条件变量时检验随机占优
articles.abstract_en: We propose tests of the conditional first- and second-order stochastic dominance in the presence of growing numbers of covariates. Our approach builds on a semiparametric location-scale model, where the conditional distribution of the outcome given the covariates is characterized by nonparametric mean and skedastic functions with independent innovations from an unknown distribution. The nonparametric regression functions are estimated by utilizing the ℓ 1 -penalized nonparametric series estimation with thresholding. Deviation bounds for the regression functions and series coefficients estimates are obtained allowing for the time series dependence. We propose test statistics, which are the maximum (integrated) deviation of a composite of the estimated regression functions and the residual empirical distribution, and introduce a smooth stationary bootstrap to compute p-values. We investigate the finite sample performance of the bootstrap critical values by a set of Monte Carlo simulations. Finally, our method is illustrated by an application to stochastic dominance among portfolio returns given all the past information.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出在协变量数量不断增长的情况下对条件一阶和二阶随机占优的检验。我们的方法基于一个半参数位置-尺度模型，其中给定协变量时结果的条件分布由非参数均值函数和方差函数以及来自未知分布的独立新息所刻画。非参数回归函数通过利用带有阈值化的 ℓ 1 惩罚非参数级数估计来估计。在允许时间序列依赖的情况下，得到了回归函数和级数系数估计的偏差界。我们提出检验统计量，它们是估计回归函数与残差经验分布复合体的最大（积分）偏差，并引入一种平滑平稳自助法来计算 p 值。我们通过一组蒙特卡洛模拟考察自助法临界值的有限样本表现。最后，我们的方法通过一个在给定所有过去信息下投资组合收益之间随机占优的应用进行了说明。

articles.title_en: Partial identification in nonseparable binary response models with endogenous regressors
articles.title_cn: 内生回归变量下不可分离二元响应模型的部分识别
articles.abstract_en: This paper considers (partial) identification of a variety of counterfactual parameters in binary response models with possibly endogenous regressors. Our framework allows for nonseparable index functions with multi-dimensional latent variables, and does not require parametric distributional assumptions. We leverage results on hyperplane arrangements and cell enumeration from the literature on computational geometry in order to provide a tractable means of computing the identified set. We demonstrate how various functional form, independence, and monotonicity assumptions can be imposed as constraints in our optimization procedure to tighten the identified set. Finally, we apply our method to study the effects of health insurance on the decision to seek medical treatment.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考虑了在可能含有内生回归变量的二元响应模型中各种反事实参数的部分识别。我们的框架允许具有多维潜在变量的不可分离指数函数，并且不需要参数分布假设。我们利用计算几何文献中关于超平面排列和单元枚举的结果，为计算识别集提供了一种可行的方法。我们展示了如何将各种函数形式、独立性和单调性假设作为约束条件施加到我们的优化过程中，以收紧识别集。最后，我们将我们的方法应用于研究健康保险对寻求医疗治疗决策的影响。

articles.title_en: Robust inference with stochastic local unit root regressors in predictive regressions
articles.title_cn: 预测回归中具有随机局部单位根回归元的稳健推断
articles.abstract_en: This paper explores predictive regression models with stochastic unit root (STUR) components and robust inference procedures that encompass a wide class of persistent and time-varying stochastically nonstationary regressors. The paper extends the mechanism of endogenously generated instrumentation known as IVX, showing that these methods remain valid for short and long-horizon predictive regressions in which the predictors have STUR and local STUR (LSTUR) generating mechanisms. Both mean regression and quantile regression methods are considered. The asymptotic distributions of the IVX estimators are new and require some new methods in their derivation. The distributions are compared to previous results and, as in earlier work, lead to pivotal limit distributions for Wald testing procedures that remain robust for both single and multiple regressors with various degrees of persistence and stochastic and fixed local departures from unit roots. Numerical experiments corroborate the asymptotic theory, and IVX testing shows good power and size control. The IVX methods are illustrated in an empirical application to evaluate the predictive capability of economic fundamentals in forecasting S&P 500 excess returns.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文探讨了具有随机单位根（STUR）成分的预测回归模型以及涵盖广泛类别的持久和时变随机非平稳回归元的稳健推断程序。本文扩展了内生生成工具变量（称为IVX）的机制，表明这些方法在预测变量具有STUR和局部STUR（LSTUR）生成机制的短期和长期预测回归中仍然有效。同时考虑了均值回归和分位数回归方法。IVX估计量的渐近分布是新的，需要一些新的推导方法。将这些分布与先前结果进行比较，并且与早期工作一样，导致Wald检验过程的枢轴极限分布，该过程对于具有各种持久性程度以及随机和固定局部偏离单位根的单回归元和多元回归元均保持稳健。数值实验证实了渐近理论，IVX检验显示出良好的功效和尺寸控制。IVX方法在实证应用中得到了说明，以评估经济基本面在预测S&P 500超额收益方面的预测能力。

articles.title_en: Model averaging for asymptotically optimal combined forecasts
articles.title_cn: 渐近最优组合预测的模型平均方法
articles.abstract_en: We propose a model-averaging (MA) method for constructing an asymptotically optimal combination of a set of point forecast sequences generated from a class of predictive regressions. The asymptotic optimality is defined in terms of approximating an unknown conditional-mean sequence based on the local(-to-zero) asymptotics. Our method has the following essential features. First, it is more general than combining a set of single point forecasts. Second, the asymptotic optimality is generally dependent on the estimation scheme and the asymptotic ratio of the length of forecast sequence relative to the in-sample size. Third, the asymptotically optimal weights may be consistently estimated under suitable conditions, while it needs the time series to be sufficiently long. We also assess the forecasting performance of our method using simulation data and real data.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种模型平均（MA）方法，用于构建由一类预测回归生成的一组点预测序列的渐近最优组合。渐近最优性是根据基于局部（趋于零）渐近性逼近未知条件均值序列来定义的。我们的方法具有以下基本特征。首先，它比组合一组单个点预测更为一般。其次，渐近最优性通常依赖于估计方案以及预测序列长度相对于样本内规模的渐近比率。第三，在适当条件下，渐近最优权重可以被一致地估计，但这需要时间序列足够长。我们还使用模拟数据和真实数据评估了我们方法的预测性能。

articles.title_en: Global robust Bayesian analysis in large models
articles.title_cn: 大型模型中的全局稳健贝叶斯分析
articles.abstract_en: This paper develops a tool for global prior sensitivity analysis in large Bayesian models. Without imposing parametric restrictions, the methodology provides bounds for posterior means or quantiles given any prior close to the original in relative entropy and reveals features of the prior that are important for the posterior statistics of interest. We develop a sequential Monte Carlo algorithm and use approximations to the likelihood and statistic of interest to implement the calculations. The methodology finds that the prior tightness hyperparameters in the hierarchical vector autoregression model from Giannone et al. (2015) are relatively insensitive to their hyperpriors. However, in the New Keynesian model of Smets and Wouters (2007), the error bands for the impulse response of output to a monetary policy shock depend heavily on the prior. The upper bound is especially sensitive, and the prior on wage rigidity plays a particularly important role.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文开发了一种用于大型贝叶斯模型中全局先验敏感性分析的工具。在不施加参数限制的情况下，该方法为在相对熵意义上接近原始先验的任何先验下的后验均值或分位数提供了界限，并揭示了对于感兴趣的后验统计量而言重要的先验特征。我们开发了一种序贯蒙特卡洛算法，并利用似然和感兴趣统计量的近似来实现计算。该方法发现，Giannone等人（2015）的层次向量自回归模型中的先验紧度超参数对其超先验相对不敏感。然而，在Smets和Wouters（2007）的新凯恩斯模型中，产出对货币政策冲击的脉冲响应的误差带在很大程度上依赖于先验。上界尤其敏感，且关于工资刚性的先验起着特别重要的作用。

articles.title_en: Discrete mixtures of normals pseudo maximum likelihood estimators of structural vector autoregressions
articles.title_cn: 结构向量自回归的离散正态混合伪极大似然估计量
articles.abstract_en: Likelihood inference in structural vector autoregressions with independent non-Gaussian shocks leads to parametric identification and efficient estimation at the risk of inconsistencies under distributional misspecification. We prove that autoregressive coefficients and (scaled) impact multipliers remain consistent, but the drifts and shocks’ standard deviations are generally inconsistent. Nevertheless, we show consistency when the non-Gaussian log-likelihood uses a discrete scale mixture of normals in the symmetric case, or an unrestricted finite mixture more generally, and compare the efficiency of these estimators to other consistent two-step proposals, including our own. Finally, our empirical application looks at dynamic linkages between three popular volatility indices.
articles.abstract_cn: 在具有独立非高斯冲击的结构向量自回归中，似然推断会导致参数识别和有效估计，但存在分布误设下不一致的风险。我们证明自回归系数和（缩放后的）影响乘数保持一致，但漂移项和冲击的标准差通常不一致。然而，我们证明了当非高斯对数似然在对称情形下使用正态的离散尺度混合，或更一般地使用无约束的有限混合时，一致性成立，并将这些估计量的效率与其他一致的两步提议（包括我们自己的）进行比较。最后，我们的实证应用考察了三个流行波动率指数之间的动态联系。

articles.title_en: Prices, profits, proxies, and production
articles.title_cn: 价格、利润、代理变量与生产
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies nonparametric identification and counterfactual bounds for heterogeneous firms that can be ranked in terms of productivity. Our approach works when quantities and prices are latent, rendering standard approaches inapplicable. Instead, we require observation of profits or other optimizing-values such as costs or revenues, and either prices or price proxies of flexibly chosen variables. We extend classical duality results for price-taking firms to a setup with discrete heterogeneity, endogeneity, and limited variation in possibly latent prices. Finally, we show that convergence results for nonparametric estimators may be directly converted to convergence results for production sets.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了可按照生产率排序的异质性企业的非参数识别与反事实界。当数量和价格不可观测时，我们的方法仍然适用，而标准方法则不再适用。相反，我们要求观测到利润或其他优化值，如成本或收入，以及灵活选择变量的价格或价格代理变量。我们将价格接受型企业的经典对偶结果扩展到具有离散异质性、内生性以及可能不可观测价格中有限变异的情形。最后，我们表明非参数估计量的收敛结果可以直接转化为生产集的收敛结果。

articles.title_en: Uniform inference in linear panel data models with two-dimensional heterogeneity
articles.title_cn: 具有二维异质性的线性面板数据模型中的一致推断
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies uniform inference in a linear panel data model when the slope coefficients may exhibit heterogeneity over both the individual and time dimensions and they can be correlated with the regressors. We propose a generalized two-way fixed effects (GTWFE) estimation procedure to estimate the model. To establish the asymptotic properties of the GTWFE estimators, we invert a number of large dimensional square matrices by approximating them with quasi-Kronecker structured matrices. We establish the asymptotic normality of our GTWFE estimators and show that their convergence rates depend on the unknown degree of parameter heterogeneity. To make a uniform inference on the common slope component, we propose a novel triple-bootstrap procedure to estimate the asymptotic variance. Simulations show the superb performance of our estimators and inference procedure. We apply our method to study the relationship between savings and investments, and find significant parameter heterogeneity along both the individual and time dimensions.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究线性面板数据模型中的一致推断，其中斜率系数可能在个体和时间两个维度上表现出异质性，并且它们可能与回归元相关。我们提出了一种广义双向固定效应（GTWFE）估计程序来估计该模型。为了建立GTWFE估计量的渐近性质，我们通过用拟Kronecker结构矩阵近似来求逆若干大维方阵。我们建立了GTWFE估计量的渐近正态性，并表明其收敛速度取决于未知的参数异质性程度。为了对共同斜率成分进行一致推断，我们提出了一种新颖的三重自助法程序来估计渐近方差。模拟显示了我们的估计量和推断程序的卓越性能。我们将我们的方法应用于研究储蓄与投资之间的关系，并发现沿个体和时间两个维度都存在显著的参数异质性。

articles.title_en: Specification tests for time-varying coefficient models
articles.title_cn: 时变系数模型的设定检验
articles.abstract_en: Time-varying coefficient models have been widely used to characterize changing relationships among economic and financial variables. The existing literature usually specifies the time-varying coefficient vector as a stationary stochastic process, a deterministic function of time, and a unit root process, respectively. In this paper, we propose two tests to distinguish these three specifications. Both test statistics follow asymptotic normal distributions under the respective null hypotheses and diverge to infinity in probability under the corresponding alternatives. To improve the finite sample performance of the tests, we propose a dependent wild bootstrap to obtain the bootstrap critical value (or P -value) and establish its asymptotic validity. Simulation studies show that our bootstrap-based tests perform reasonably well in finite samples. We apply the proposed tests to the time-varying specifications of the equity return’s predictive model, the U.S. Taylor rule, and inflation persistence, respectively. The results suggest that a unit root process is favored for the first application, whereas a deterministic function of time should be adopted for the latter two applications.
articles.abstract_cn: 时变系数模型已被广泛用于刻画经济与金融变量之间不断变化的关系。现有文献通常分别将时变系数向量设定为平稳随机过程、时间的确定性函数以及单位根过程。本文提出两个检验来区分这三种设定。两个检验统计量在各自的原假设下均服从渐近正态分布，并在相应的备择假设下依概率发散到无穷。为改进检验的有限样本表现，我们提出一种相依野自助法以获得自助临界值（或 P 值），并建立其渐近有效性。模拟研究表明，我们基于自助法的检验在有限样本中表现合理。我们将所提出的检验分别应用于股票收益率预测模型、美国泰勒规则和通胀持续性的时变设定。结果表明，第一个应用倾向于单位根过程，而后两个应用应采用时间的确定性函数。

articles.title_en: A GMM approach to estimate the roughness of stochastic volatility
articles.title_cn: 估计随机波动率粗糙度的GMM方法
articles.abstract_en: We develop a GMM approach for estimation of log-normal stochastic volatility models driven by a fractional Brownian motion with unrestricted Hurst exponent. We show that a parameter estimator based on the integrated variance is consistent and, under stronger conditions, asymptotically normally distributed. We inspect the behavior of our procedure when integrated variance is replaced with a noisy measure of volatility calculated from discrete high-frequency data. The realized estimator contains sampling error, which skews the fractal coefficient toward “illusive roughness.” We construct an analytical approach to control the impact of measurement error without introducing nuisance parameters. In a simulation study, we demonstrate convincing small sample properties of our approach based both on integrated and realized variance over the entire memory spectrum. We show the bias correction attenuates any systematic deviance in the parameter estimates. Our procedure is applied to empirical high-frequency data from numerous leading equity indexes. With our robust approach the Hurst index is estimated around 0.05, confirming roughness in stochastic volatility.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一种GMM方法，用于估计由具有无限制Hurst指数的分数布朗运动驱动的对数正态随机波动率模型。我们证明，基于积分方差的参数估计量是一致的，并且在更强的条件下渐近正态分布。我们考察了当积分方差被由离散高频数据计算得到的波动率噪声度量替代时，我们程序的行为。已实现估计量包含抽样误差，这会使分形系数偏向“虚假粗糙”。我们构建了一种分析方法来控制测量误差的影响，而不引入冗余参数。在模拟研究中，我们展示了我们的方法在整个记忆谱上基于积分方差和已实现方差的令人信服的小样本性质。我们表明偏差校正减弱了参数估计中的任何系统性偏差。我们的程序应用于来自众多领先股票指数的经验高频数据。使用我们的稳健方法，Hurst指数估计约为0.05，证实了随机波动率中的粗糙性。

articles.title_en: News-implied linkages and local dependency in the equity market
articles.title_cn: 股市中新闻隐含的关联与局部依赖性
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies a heterogeneous coefficient spatial factor model that separately addresses both common factor risks (strong cross-sectional dependence) and local dependency (weak cross-sectional dependence) in equity returns. From the asset pricing perspective, we derive the theoretical implications of no asymptotic arbitrage for the heterogeneous spatial factor model, generalizing the work of Kou et al. (2018). We also provide the associated Wald tests for the APT restrictions in the general case when there are both traded and non-traded factors. On the empirical side, it is challenging to measure granular firm-to-firm connectivity for a high-dimensional panel of equity returns. We use extensive business news to construct firms’ links through which local shocks transmit, and we use those news-implied linkages as a proxy for the connectivity among firms. Empirically, we document a considerable degree of local dependency among S&P500 stocks, and the spatial component does a great job in capturing the remaining correlations in the de-factored returns. We find that adding spatial interaction terms to factor models reduces mispricing and boosts model fitting. By comparing the performance of the model estimated using different networks, we show that the news-implied linkages provide a comprehensive and integrated proxy for firm-to-firm connectivity.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了一个异质系数空间因子模型，该模型分别处理股票收益中的共同因子风险（强横截面依赖）和局部依赖性（弱横截面依赖）。从资产定价的角度，我们推导了无异步套利对异质空间因子模型的理论含义，推广了Kou et al. (2018)的工作。我们还提供了在同时存在可交易和不可交易因子的一般情况下，针对APT限制的相关Wald检验。在实证方面，对于高维股票收益面板，衡量细粒度的公司间连通性具有挑战性。我们使用大量商业新闻来构建公司间的链接，局部冲击通过这些链接传导，并将这些新闻隐含的关联作为公司间连通性的代理。实证上，我们记录了S&P500股票之间存在相当程度的局部依赖性，并且空间成分在捕捉去因子化收益中的剩余相关性方面表现优异。我们发现，在因子模型中加入空间交互项可以减少错误定价并提升模型拟合。通过比较使用不同网络估计的模型性能，我们表明新闻隐含的关联为公司间连通性提供了一个全面且综合的代理。

articles.title_en: Threshold regression with nonparametric sample splitting
articles.title_cn: 非参数样本分割的阈值回归
articles.abstract_en: This paper develops a threshold regression model where an unknown relationship between two variables nonparametrically determines the threshold. We allow the observations to be cross-sectionally dependent so that the model can be applied to determine an unknown spatial border for sample splitting over a random field. We derive the uniform rate of convergence and the nonstandard limiting distribution of the nonparametric threshold estimator. We also obtain the root-n consistency and the asymptotic normality of the regression coefficient estimator. We illustrate empirical relevance of this new model by estimating the tipping point in social segregation problems as a function of demographic characteristics; and determining metropolitan area boundaries using nighttime light intensity collected from satellite imagery.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文构建了一个阈值回归模型，其中两个变量之间的未知关系以非参数方式确定阈值。我们允许观测值存在截面相依性，从而该模型可用于在随机场上确定未知的空间边界以进行样本分割。我们推导了非参数阈值估计量的一致收敛速率和非标准极限分布。我们还得到了回归系数估计量的根号n相合性和渐近正态性。我们通过估计社会隔离问题中作为人口特征函数的临界点，以及利用卫星图像收集的夜间灯光强度确定大都市区边界，来说明这一新模型的经验相关性。

articles.title_en: Variance–covariance from a metropolis chain on a curved, singular manifold
articles.title_cn: 弯曲奇异流形上Metropolis链的方差-协方差
articles.abstract_en: We consider estimation of variance and covariance from a point cloud that are draws from a posterior distribution that lie on a curved, singular manifold. The motivating application is Bayesian inference regarding a likelihood subject to overidentified moment equations using MCMC (Markov Chain Monte Carlo). The MCMC draws lie on a singular manifold that typically is curved. Variance and covariance are Euclidean concepts. A curved, singular manifold is not typically a Euclidean space. We explore some suggestions on how to adapt a Euclidean concept to a non-Euclidean space then build on them to propose and illustrate appropriate methods.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考虑从位于弯曲奇异流形上的后验分布抽取的点云中估计方差和协方差。动机应用是使用MCMC（马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛）对受过度识别矩方程约束的似然进行贝叶斯推断。MCMC抽取位于通常弯曲的奇异流形上。方差和协方差是欧几里得概念。弯曲奇异流形通常不是欧几里得空间。我们探讨一些关于如何将欧几里得概念适应非欧几里得空间的建议，然后在此基础上提出并说明适当的方法。

articles.title_en: Identification and inference of network formation games with misclassified links
articles.title_cn: 存在误分类链接的网络形成博弈的识别与推断
articles.abstract_en: This paper considers a network formation model when links are potentially misclassified. We focus on a game-theoretical model of strategic network formation with incomplete information, in which the linking decisions depend on agents’ exogenous attributes and endogenous network characteristics. In the presence of link misclassification, we derive moment conditions that characterize the identified set for the preference parameters associated with homophily and network externalities. Based on the moment equality conditions, we provide an inference method that is asymptotically valid when a single network of many agents is observed. Finally, we apply our misclassification-robust method to study the preference parameters of a lending network in rural villages in southern India.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考虑链接可能被误分类时的网络形成模型。我们关注一个具有不完全信息的策略性网络形成博弈论模型，其中链接决策取决于代理人的外生属性和内生网络特征。在存在链接误分类的情况下，我们推导出矩条件，这些矩条件刻画了与同质性和网络外部性相关的偏好参数的识别集。基于矩等式条件，我们提供了一种当观察到由许多代理人构成的单一网络时渐近有效的推断方法。最后，我们将我们的误分类稳健方法应用于研究印度南部农村村庄借贷网络的偏好参数。

articles.title_en: Using monotonicity restrictions to identify models with partially latent covariates
articles.title_cn: 利用单调性限制识别具有部分潜在协变量的模型
articles.abstract_en: This paper develops a new method for identifying econometric models with partially latent covariates. Such data structures arise in industrial organization and labor economics settings where data are collected using an input-based sampling strategy, e.g., if the sampling unit is one of multiple labor input factors. We show that the latent covariates can be nonparametrically identified, if they are functions of a common shock satisfying some plausible monotonicity assumptions. With the latent covariates identified, semiparametric estimation of the outcome equation proceeds within a standard IV framework that accounts for the endogeneity of the covariates. We illustrate the usefulness of our method using a new application that focuses on the production functions of pharmacies. We find that differences in technology between chains and independent pharmacies may partially explain the observed transformation of the industry structure.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一种识别具有部分潜在协变量的计量经济学模型的新方法。这种数据结构出现在产业组织和劳动经济学环境中，其中数据是使用基于投入的抽样策略收集的，例如，如果抽样单位是多个劳动投入因素之一。我们表明，如果潜在协变量是满足一些合理的单调性假设的共同冲击的函数，则它们可以被非参数识别。在潜在协变量被识别后，结果方程的半参数估计在一个标准的IV框架内进行，该框架考虑了协变量的内生性。我们通过一个关注药房生产函数的新应用来说明我们方法的有用性。我们发现，连锁药房和独立药房之间的技术差异可能部分解释了观察到的行业结构转变。

articles.title_en: Using large samples in econometrics
articles.title_cn: 在计量经济学中使用大样本
articles.abstract_en: As I demonstrate using evidence from a journal data repository that I manage, the datasets used in empirical work are getting larger. When we use very large datasets, it can be dangerous to rely on standard methods for statistical inference. In addition, we need to worry about computational issues. We must be careful in our choice of statistical methods and the algorithms used to implement them.
articles.abstract_cn: 正如我利用我所管理的一个期刊数据存储库中的证据所展示的，实证工作中使用的数据集正变得越来越大。当我们使用非常大的数据集时，依赖标准的统计推断方法可能是危险的。此外，我们还需要担心计算问题。我们必须在统计方法的选择以及用于实现这些方法的算法上保持谨慎。

articles.title_en: Profile GMM estimation of panel data models with interactive fixed effects
articles.title_cn: 交互固定效应面板数据模型的轮廓GMM估计
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies panel data models with interactive fixed effects where the regressors are allowed to be correlated with the idiosyncratic error terms. We propose a two-step profile GMM estimation procedure to estimate the parameters of interest. In the first step we obtain a preliminary consistent estimate of the slope coefficient via a nuclear-norm-regularization (NNR) based profile GMM procedure. In the second step, via an iterative procedure, we conduct post-NNR profile GMM estimation of the slope coefficient, factors, and factor loadings, with an improved convergence rate for the estimate of the slope coefficient. We establish the asymptotic properties of the preliminary estimates and the iterative estimates, and propose an efficient profile GMM estimator. We also study the determination of the number of factors and propose Hausman tests for the exogeneity of the regressor. Monte Carlo simulations suggest that the proposed estimation and testing methods work well in the determination of the number of factors, the estimation of the model parameters and the test for exogeneity. As an empirical application, we apply our model and method to study the price elasticity of U.S. imports.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究回归量允许与特质误差项相关的交互固定效应面板数据模型。我们提出一个两步轮廓GMM估计程序来估计感兴趣的参数。在第一步中，我们通过基于核范数正则化（NNR）的轮廓GMM程序获得斜率系数的初步一致估计。在第二步中，通过迭代程序，我们对斜率系数、因子和因子载荷进行后NNR轮廓GMM估计，并改进了斜率系数估计的收敛速度。我们建立初步估计和迭代估计的渐近性质，并提出一个有效轮廓GMM估计量。我们还研究因子个数的确定，并提出回归量外生性的Hausman检验。蒙特卡洛模拟表明，所提出的估计和检验方法在因子个数确定、模型参数估计和外生性检验方面表现良好。作为实证应用，我们将我们的模型和方法应用于研究美国进口的价格弹性。

articles.title_en: Bootstrap specification tests for dynamic conditional distribution models
articles.title_cn: 动态条件分布模型的Bootstrap设定检验
articles.abstract_en: This paper proposes bootstrap based tests for the specification of a given parametric conditional distribution in autoregressive time series with GARCH-type disturbances. The tests are based on an estimated residual empirical process and are implemented by parametric bootstrap. We show that the proposed tests are asymptotically valid, consistent, and have nontrivial asymptotic power against a large proportion of local alternatives. Our approach relies on non-primitive regularity conditions and certain properties of exponential almost sure convergence. The regularity conditions are shown to be satisfied by GARCH(p,q); this technique of verification is applicable to other models as well. In our Monte Carlo study, the proposed tests performed well and better than several competing tests, including the information matrix test. A real data example illustrates the testing procedure.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文提出了基于Bootstrap的检验方法，用于检验带有GARCH型扰动的自回归时间序列中给定参数条件分布的设定。这些检验基于估计的残差经验过程，并通过参数Bootstrap实现。我们证明所提出的检验是渐近有效的、一致的，并且对很大一部分局部备择假设具有非平凡的渐近功效。我们的方法依赖于非本原正则条件以及指数几乎必然收敛的某些性质。这些正则条件被证明可由GARCH(p,q)满足；这种验证技术也适用于其他模型。在我们的蒙特卡洛研究中，所提出的检验表现良好，并且优于若干竞争检验，包括信息矩阵检验。一个真实数据例子说明了该检验程序。

articles.title_en: Testing the martingale difference hypothesis in high dimension
articles.title_cn: 高维鞅差假设的检验
articles.abstract_en: In this paper, we consider testing the martingale difference hypothesis for high-dimensional time series. Our test is built on the sum of squares of the element-wise max-norm of the proposed matrix-valued nonlinear dependence measure at different lags. To conduct the inference, we approximate the null distribution of our test statistic by Gaussian approximation and provide a simulation-based approach to generate critical values. The asymptotic behavior of the test statistic under the alternative is also studied. Our approach is nonparametric as the null hypothesis only assumes the time series concerned is martingale difference without specifying any parametric forms of its conditional moments. As an advantage of Gaussian approximation, our test is robust to the cross-series dependence of unknown magnitude. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first valid test for the martingale difference hypothesis that not only allows for large dimension but also captures nonlinear serial dependence. The practical usefulness of our test is illustrated via simulation and a real data analysis. The test is implemented in a user-friendly R-function.
articles.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们考虑对高维时间序列的鞅差假设进行检验。我们的检验基于所提出的矩阵值非线性依赖度量在不同滞后阶数下逐元素最大范数的平方和。为进行推断，我们通过高斯近似来逼近检验统计量的原分布，并提供一种基于模拟的方法来生成临界值。我们还研究了检验统计量在备择假设下的渐近行为。我们的方法是非参数的，因为原假设仅假定所关注的时间序列是鞅差，而未指定其条件矩的任何参数形式。作为高斯近似的一个优势，我们的检验对未知大小的跨序列依赖具有稳健性。据我们所知，这是第一个有效的鞅差假设检验，它不仅允许大维度，而且还能捕捉非线性序列依赖。我们通过模拟和真实数据分析说明了检验的实际有用性。该检验在一个用户友好的R函数中实现。

articles.title_en: Semiparametric partially linear varying coefficient modal regression
articles.title_cn: 半参数部分线性变系数众数回归
articles.abstract_en: We in this paper propose a semiparametric partially linear varying coefficient (SPLVC) modal regression, in which the conditional mode function of the response variable given covariates admits a partially linear varying coefficient structure. In comparison to existing regressions, the newly developed SPLVC modal regression captures the “most likely” effect and provides superior prediction performance when the data distribution is skewed. The consistency and asymptotic properties of the resultant estimators for both parametric and nonparametric parts are rigorously established. We employ a kernel-based objective function to simplify the computation and a modified modal-expectation–maximization (MEM) algorithm to estimate the model numerically. Furthermore, taking the residual sums of modes as the loss function, we construct a goodness-of-fit testing statistic for hypotheses on the coefficient functions, whose limiting null distribution is shown to follow an asymptotically χ 2 -distribution with a scale dependent on density functions. To achieve sparsity in the high-dimensional SPLVC modal regression, we develop a regularized estimation procedure by imposing a penalty on the coefficients in the parametric part to eliminate the irrelevant variables. Monte Carlo simulations and two real-data applications are conducted to examine the performance of the suggested estimation methods and hypothesis test. We also briefly explore the extension of the SPLVC modal regression to the case where some varying coefficient functions admit higher-order smoothness.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一种半参数部分线性变系数（SPLVC）众数回归，其中响应变量在给定协变量下的条件众数函数具有部分线性变系数结构。与现有回归相比，新提出的SPLVC众数回归捕捉了“最可能”效应，并在数据分布偏斜时提供了更优的预测性能。对于参数部分和非参数部分所得估计量的一致性和渐近性质，我们进行了严格建立。我们采用基于核的目标函数来简化计算，并使用改进的众数-期望-最大化（MEM）算法对模型进行数值估计。此外，以众数残差平方和作为损失函数，我们构造了一个用于检验系数函数假设的拟合优度检验统计量，其极限零分布被证明服从渐近χ 2 -分布，尺度依赖于密度函数。为了实现高维SPLVC众数回归中的稀疏性，我们通过对参数部分的系数施加惩罚来开发一种正则化估计程序，以消除无关变量。我们进行了蒙特卡洛模拟和两个实际数据应用，以检验所建议的估计方法和假设检验的性能。我们还简要探讨了将SPLVC众数回归扩展到某些变系数函数具有更高阶光滑性的情形。

articles.title_en: Indirect inference estimation of dynamic panel data models
articles.title_cn: 动态面板数据模型的间接推断估计
articles.abstract_en: This paper proposes an estimator for higher-order dynamic panel models based on the idea of indirect inference by matching the simple within-group estimator with its analytical approximate expectation. The resulting estimator is shown to be consistent and asymptotically normal. For the special case of first-order dynamic panel, the estimator yields numerically the same result from an existing procedure in the literature, but the inference to follow differs and this paper examines the differences and implications for hypothesis testing. Monte Carlo simulations show that the proposed estimator is virtually unbiased, achieves usually lower root mean squared error than competing estimators, and delivers very reliable empirical size across various parameter configurations and error distributions. This new estimator is used to estimate the convergence parameter in an inequality measure among 63 countries during 1985–2015. It shows strong evidence of convergence over long test horizons but much weaker evidence over a 5-year horizon for developing countries.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文基于间接推断的思想，通过将简单的组内估计量与其解析近似期望相匹配，提出了一种用于高阶动态面板模型的估计量。所得到的估计量被证明具有一致性和渐近正态性。对于一阶动态面板的特殊情形，该估计量在数值上与文献中已有程序的结果相同，但后续推断有所不同，本文考察了这些差异及其对假设检验的含义。蒙特卡洛模拟表明，所提出的估计量几乎无偏，通常比竞争估计量具有更低的均方根误差，并在各种参数配置和误差分布下提供非常可靠的经验检验水平。这一新估计量被用于估计63个国家在1985-2015期间不平等度量中的收敛参数。它显示出在较长检验期上收敛的强证据，但对发展中国家在5年期限上的证据则弱得多。

articles.title_en: Macroeconomic forecasting and variable ordering in multivariate stochastic volatility models
articles.title_cn: 多变量随机波动率模型中的宏观经济预测与变量排序
articles.abstract_en: We document five novel empirical findings on the well-known potential ordering drawback associated with the time-varying parameter vector autoregression with stochastic volatility developed by Cogley and Sargent (2005) and Primiceri (2005). First, the ordering does not affect point prediction. Second, the standard deviation of the predictive densities implied by different orderings can differ substantially. Third, the average length of the prediction intervals is also sensitive to the ordering. Fourth, the best ordering for one variable in terms of log-predictive scores does not necessarily imply the best ordering for another variable under the same metric. Fifth, the ordering problem becomes exacerbated in conditional forecasting exercises. Then, we consider three alternative ordering invariant models: a canonical discounted Wishart stochastic volatility model and two dynamic stochastic correlation models. When the forecasting performance of these ordering invariant models is compared to Cogley, Primiceri, and Sargent’s ordering variant model, the former underperforms relative to all orderings and the latter two have an out-of-sample forecasting performance comparable with the median outcomes across orderings.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们记录了关于由Cogley和Sargent（2005）以及Primiceri（2005）开发的带有随机波动率的时变参数向量自回归所伴随的著名潜在排序缺陷的五个新颖实证发现。第一，排序不影响点预测。第二，不同排序所隐含的预测密度标准差可能差异很大。第三，预测区间的平均长度也对排序敏感。第四，就对数预测得分而言，一个变量的最佳排序不一定意味着在同一度量下另一个变量的最佳排序。第五，排序问题在条件预测练习中加剧。然后，我们考虑三个替代的排序不变模型：一个典型贴现Wishart随机波动率模型和两个动态随机相关模型。当将这些排序不变模型的预测性能与Cogley、Primiceri和Sargent的排序可变模型进行比较时，前者相对于所有排序表现不佳，而后者两个的样本外预测性能与跨排序的中位数结果相当。

articles.title_en: Nonparametric identification and estimation of the extended Roy model
articles.title_cn: 扩展Roy模型的非参数识别与估计
articles.abstract_en: We propose a new identification method for the extended Roy model, in which the agents maximize their utility rather than just their outcome. We nonparametrically identify the joint distribution of potential outcomes, which is of great importance in causal inference. We exploit the extended Roy model structure and the monotonicity assumption but do not require any functional form assumption nor any support assumption. The identification is achieved by matching the indifferent agents across choices, who are identified by the local instrumental variable method. Based on the identification result, we propose an easy-to-implement nonparametric simulation-based estimator and derive its convergence rate. An empirical illustration on Malawian farmers’ hybrid maize adoption is provided.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种扩展Roy模型的新识别方法，其中代理人最大化其效用而非仅最大化其产出。我们非参数地识别潜在结果的联合分布，这在因果推断中至关重要。我们利用扩展Roy模型结构和单调性假设，但不要求任何函数形式假设或任何支撑假设。识别通过匹配不同选择间的无差异代理人来实现，这些代理人由局部工具变量方法识别。基于识别结果，我们提出了一种易于实施的基于模拟的非参数估计量，并推导了其收敛速度。文中提供了关于马拉维农民杂交玉米采纳的实证例证。

articles.title_en: Lasso inference for high-dimensional time series
articles.title_cn: 高维时间序列的Lasso推断
articles.abstract_en: In this paper we develop valid inference for high-dimensional time series. We extend the desparsified lasso to a time series setting under Near-Epoch Dependence (NED) assumptions allowing for non-Gaussian, serially correlated and heteroskedastic processes, where the number of regressors can possibly grow faster than the time dimension. We first derive an error bound under weak sparsity, which, coupled with the NED assumption, means this inequality can also be applied to the (inherently misspecified) nodewise regressions performed in the desparsified lasso. This allows us to establish the uniform asymptotic normality of the desparsified lasso under general conditions, including for inference on parameters of increasing dimensions. Additionally, we show consistency of a long-run variance estimator, thus providing a complete set of tools for performing inference in high-dimensional linear time series models. Finally, we perform a simulation exercise to demonstrate the small sample properties of the desparsified lasso in common time series settings.
articles.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们为高维时间序列开发了有效的推断方法。我们将去稀疏化Lasso扩展到近邻依赖（NED）假设下的时间序列设定，允许非高斯、序列相关和异方差过程，其中回归元数量可能比时间维度增长得更快。我们首先在弱稀疏性下推导出一个误差界，结合NED假设，这意味着该不等式也可以应用于去稀疏化Lasso中执行的（固有误设的）逐节点回归。这使我们能够在一般条件下建立去稀疏化Lasso的一致渐近正态性，包括对递增维数参数的推断。此外，我们证明了长期方差估计量的一致性，从而为高维线性时间序列模型中的推断提供了一套完整的工具。最后，我们进行了模拟练习，以展示去稀疏化Lasso在常见时间序列设定中的小样本性质。

articles.title_en: ETF Basket-Adjusted Covariance estimation
articles.title_cn: ETF篮子调整协方差估计
articles.abstract_en: The increase in trading frequency of Exchanged Traded Funds (ETFs) presents a positive externality for financial risk management when the price of the ETF is available at a higher frequency than the price of the component stocks. The positive spillover consists in improving the accuracy of pre-estimators of the integrated covariance of the stocks included in the ETF basket. The proposed ETF Basket-Adjusted Covariance (BAC) equals the pre-estimator plus a minimal adjustment matrix such that the covariance-implied stock-ETF covariation equals a target value. We focus on a truncated pre-averaged version of the (Hayashi and Yoshida, 2005) pre-estimator and derive the asymptotic properties of its implied stock-ETF covariation. The simulation study confirms that the accuracy gains are substantial in all cases considered. In the empirical part of the paper, we show the gains in tracking error efficiency when using the BAC adjustment to construct portfolios that replicate a broad index using a subset of stocks.
articles.abstract_cn: 当交易所交易基金（ETF）的价格比其成分股的价格以更高频率可得时，ETF交易频率的增加为金融风险管理带来了正外部性。这种正溢出效应体现在提高了对ETF篮子中所包含股票的积分协方差预估计量的准确性。所提出的ETF篮子调整协方差（BAC）等于预估计量加上一个最小调整矩阵，使得协方差隐含的股票-ETF协变等于目标值。我们聚焦于（Hayashi and Yoshida, 2005）预估计量的截断预平均版本，并推导其隐含的股票-ETF协变的渐近性质。模拟研究证实，在所有考虑的情形中，准确性增益都是显著的。在论文的实证部分，我们展示了当使用BAC调整来构建利用股票子集复制广泛指数的投资组合时，在跟踪误差效率方面的增益。

articles.title_en: Distinguishing incentive from selection effects in auction-determined contracts
articles.title_cn: 区分拍卖决定合同中的激励效应与选择效应
articles.abstract_en: This paper develops a novel approach to estimate how contract and principal–agent characteristics influence a post-auction outcome when the matching between agents and principals derives from an auction process. We propose a control-function approach to account jointly for the endogeneity of contracts and matching. This consists of, first, estimating the primitives of an interdependent values auction model – which is shown to be non-parametrically identified from the bidding data – second, constructing control functions based on the distribution of the unobserved private signals conditional on the auction outcome. A Monte Carlo study shows that our augmented outcome equation corrects the endogeneity biases well, even in small samples. We apply our methodology to a labor market application and estimate the effect of sports players’ auction-determined wages on their individual performances. We also use our structural estimates to evaluate the strength of matching inefficiencies and assess counterfactual reservation wage policies.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一种新颖的方法，用于估计当代理人—委托人之间的匹配源自拍卖过程时，合同和委托人—代理人特征如何影响拍卖后结果。我们提出了一种控制函数方法，以联合处理合同和匹配的内生性。这包括：首先，估计一个相互依赖价值拍卖模型的基本参数——该模型被证明可以从投标数据中非参数识别；其次，基于以拍卖结果为条件的未观测私人信号分布构建控制函数。一项蒙特卡洛研究表明，我们的增广结果方程即使在小型样本中也能很好地校正内生性偏差。我们将该方法应用于一个劳动力市场案例，估计体育运动员由拍卖决定的工资对其个人表现的影响。我们还使用结构估计来评估匹配无效率的强度，并评估反事实保留工资政策。

articles.title_en: Peer effects and endogenous social interactions
articles.title_cn: 同伴效应与内生社会互动
articles.abstract_en: This paper proposes a solution to the problem of endogenous selection of peers in the linear-in-means model. We do not require to specify a model for how the selection of peers comes about. Rather, we exploit two restrictions that are inherent in many such specifications to construct conditional moment conditions. The restrictions in question are that link decisions that involve a given individual are not all independent of one another, but that they are independent of the link decisions made between other pairs of individuals that are located sufficiently far away in the network. These conditions imply that instrumental variables can be constructed from leave-own-out networks.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文提出了线性均值模型中同伴内生选择问题的一种解决方案。我们不需要为同伴选择如何产生指定一个模型。相反，我们利用许多此类设定中固有的两个限制来构造条件矩条件。所讨论的限制是，涉及给定个体的链接决策并非彼此全部独立，但它们与网络中距离足够远的其他个体对之间的链接决策独立。这些条件意味着可以从留一自身网络中构造工具变量。

articles.title_en: The role of score and information bias in panel data likelihoods
articles.title_cn: 得分和信息偏差在面板数据似然中的作用
articles.abstract_en: We show why reducing information bias can improve the performance of likelihood based estimators and confidence regions in small samples, and why it seems to matter more for inference than for estimation. The insights in this paper are helpful in explaining several simulation findings in the panel data literature. E.g., we can explain the well documented phenomenon that reducing the score bias alone often reduces the finite sample variance of estimators and improves the coverage of confidence regions in small samples, and why confidence regions based on conditional (on sufficient statistics) likelihoods can have excellent coverage even in very short panels. We can also explain the simulation results in Schumann, Severini, and Tripathi (2021), who find that, in short panels, estimators and confidence regions based on pseudolikelihoods that are simultaneously first-order score and information unbiased perform much better than those based on pseudolikelihoods that are only first-order score unbiased.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们展示了为什么减少信息偏差可以提高小样本中基于似然的估计量和置信区域的性能，以及为什么它似乎对推断比对估计更重要。本文的见解有助于解释面板数据文献中的若干模拟发现。例如，我们可以解释一个被充分记录的現象：仅减少得分偏差往往就能降低估计量的小样本方差，并改善小样本中置信区域的覆盖率，以及为什么基于条件（充分统计量）似然的置信区域即使在非常短的面板中也能具有极好的覆盖率。我们还可以解释Schumann、Severini和Tripathi（2021）中的模拟结果，他们发现，在短面板中，基于同时具有一阶得分和信息无偏的伪似然的估计量和置信区域，比仅具有一阶得分无偏的伪似然表现好得多。

articles.title_en: Community network auto-regression for high-dimensional time series
articles.title_cn: 高维时间序列的社区网络自回归
articles.abstract_en: Modeling responses on the nodes of a large-scale network is an important task that arises commonly in practice. This paper proposes a community network vector autoregressive (CNAR) model, which utilizes the network structure to characterize the dependence and intra-community homogeneity of the high-dimensional time series. The CNAR model greatly increases the flexibility and generality of the network vector autoregressive (NAR) model proposed by Zhu et al. (2017) by allowing heterogeneous network effects across different network communities. In addition, the non-community-related latent factors are included to account for unknown cross-sectional dependence. The number of network communities can diverge as the network expands, which leads to estimating a diverging number of model parameters. We obtain a set of stationary conditions and develop an efficient two-step weighted least-squares estimator. The consistency and asymptotic normality properties of the estimators are established. Theoretical results show that the two-step estimator can further improve the efficiency of one-step estimator when the error admits a factor structure. The advantages of the CNAR model are illustrated on a variety of synthetic and real datasets.
articles.abstract_cn: 对大规模网络节点上的响应进行建模是实践中常见的一项重要任务。本文提出了一种社区网络向量自回归（CNAR）模型，该模型利用网络结构来刻画高维时间序列的依赖性和社区内同质性。CNAR模型通过允许不同网络社区之间存在异质性网络效应，极大地提高了Zhu等（2017）提出的网络向量自回归（NAR）模型的灵活性和一般性。此外，模型还纳入了与社区无关的潜在因子，以解释未知的横截面依赖。随着网络的扩展，网络社区的数量可能发散，这导致需要估计数量发散的模型参数。我们获得了一组平稳性条件，并开发了一种高效的两步加权最小二乘估计量。建立了估计量的一致性和渐近正态性性质。理论结果表明，当误差具有因子结构时，两步估计量可以进一步提高一步估计量的效率。CNAR模型的优势在多种合成数据集和真实数据集上得到了展示。

articles.title_en: Nonparametric identification and estimation with discrete instruments and regressors
articles.title_cn: 离散工具变量和回归变量的非参数识别与估计
articles.abstract_en: In a nonparametric instrumental regression model in which the regressor and instrument are discretely distributed, we strengthen the conventional moment independence assumption between instrument and residual to include higher order moments. We give conditions under which a function of interest is partially identified when the regressor has more mass points than the instrument. We also show that the function is point identified as long as certain latent parameters corresponding to conditional moments of the residual lie outside of a set of measure zero. We give an asymptotically normal estimator for the structural function when it is point identified. We also provide a straightforward method for inference under partial identification. These perform well in Monte-Carlo simulations and in two empirical applications.
articles.abstract_cn: 在一个回归变量和工具变量均为离散分布的非参数工具变量回归模型中，我们将工具变量与残差之间传统的矩独立性假设强化为包含更高阶矩。我们给出了当回归变量的质量点多于工具变量时，感兴趣的函数被部分识别的条件。我们还表明，只要对应于残差条件矩的某些潜在参数位于一个测度为零的集合之外，该函数就是点识别的。当结构函数为点识别时，我们给出了一个渐近正态估计量。我们还提供了一种在部分识别下进行推断的简便方法。这些方法在蒙特卡洛模拟和两个实证应用中表现良好。

articles.title_en: Asymptotic F test in regressions with observations collected at high frequency over long span
articles.title_cn: 在高频率长时间跨度观测数据的回归中的渐近F检验
articles.abstract_en: This paper proposes tests of linear hypotheses when the variables may be continuous-time processes with observations collected at a high sampling frequency over a long span. Utilizing series long run variance (LRV) estimation in place of the traditional kernel LRV estimation, we develop easy-to-implement and more accurate F tests in both stationary and nonstationary environments. The nonstationary environment accommodates exogenous regressors that are general semimartingales. Endogenous regressors are allowed in a nonstationary environment similar to cointegration models in the usual discrete-time setting. The F tests can be implemented in exactly the same way as in the discrete-time setting. The F tests are, therefore, robust to the continuous-time or discrete-time nature of the data. Simulations demonstrate the improved size accuracy and competitive power of the F tests relative to existing continuous-time testing procedures and their improved versions. The F tests are of practical interest as recent work by Chang et al. (2021) demonstrates that traditional inference methods can become invalid and produce spurious results when continuous-time processes are observed on finer grids over a long span.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文提出当变量可能是连续时间过程且观测数据在长时间跨度内以高采样频率收集时的线性假设检验。利用序列长期方差（LRV）估计代替传统的核LRV估计，我们在平稳和非平稳环境中开发了易于实施且更准确的F检验。非平稳环境容纳了作为一般半鞅的外生回归元。在非平稳环境中，允许内生回归元，类似于通常离散时间设定中的协整模型。F检验可以完全按照离散时间设定中的方式实施。因此，F检验对数据的连续时间或离散时间性质具有稳健性。模拟表明，相对于现有的连续时间检验程序及其改进版本，F检验具有改进的规模准确性和有竞争力的功效。F检验具有实际意义，因为Chang et al. (2021) 的近期工作表明，当连续时间过程在长时间跨度内以更细的网格观测时，传统推断方法可能变得无效并产生虚假结果。

articles.title_en: Two-step estimation of censored quantile regression for duration models with time-varying regressors
articles.title_cn: 含时变回归变量的持续时间模型删失分位数回归的两步估计
articles.abstract_en: Common duration models are characterized by strong homogeneity and thus are highly restrictive in allowing for how regressors affect the conditional duration distribution. In particular, the implied sign and relative marginal quantile effects remain the same over the entire range of the conditional duration distribution, which rules out general heterogeneous effects in duration data. Quantile regression, which offers a flexible and unified framework that allows for general heterogeneous effects, is particularly well suited to duration analysis. Based on the insights behind the accelerated failure time model (AFT) with time-varying regressors (Cox and Oakes, 1984) and the standard quantile regression model (Koenker and Bassett, 1978), Chen (2019) recently developed a quantile regression framework with time-varying regressors. However, Chen’s (2019) estimator is very difficult to compute because the estimation procedure involves a non-convex and nonlinear high dimensional optimization problem due to censoring and the nonlinearity of the quantile function. In this paper I propose an easy-to-implement two-step quantile regression estimator, which significantly reduces the computational burden. The estimator is shown to be consistent and asymptotically normal. Monte Carlo experiments indicate that our estimator perform well in finite samples.
articles.abstract_cn: 常见的持续时间模型具有强烈的同质性特征，因此在允许回归变量如何影响条件持续时间分布方面具有高度限制性。特别是，隐含的符号和相对边际分位数效应在条件持续时间分布的整个范围内保持不变，这排除了持续时间数据中的一般异质性效应。分位数回归提供了一个灵活且统一的框架，允许一般异质性效应，特别适合持续时间分析。基于含时变回归变量的加速失效时间模型（AFT）（Cox and Oakes, 1984）和标准分位数回归模型（Koenker and Bassett, 1978）背后的洞见，Chen（2019）最近开发了一个含时变回归变量的分位数回归框架。然而，Chen（2019）的估计量非常难以计算，因为由于删失和分位数函数的非线性，估计过程涉及一个非凸且非线性的高维优化问题。在本文中，我提出了一个易于实施的两步分位数回归估计量，显著减少了计算负担。该估计量被证明是一致的且渐近正态的。蒙特卡洛实验表明，我们的估计量在有限样本中表现良好。

articles.title_en: Testing and signal identification for two-sample high-dimensional covariances via multi-level thresholding
articles.title_cn: 基于多级阈值化的两样本高维协方差检验与信号识别
articles.abstract_en: The paper considers testing and signal identification for covariance matrices from two populations of marginally sub-Gaussian distributed. A multi-level thresholding procedure is proposed for testing the equality of two high-dimensional covariance matrices, which is designed to detect sparse and faint differences between the covariances. A novel U -statistic composition is developed to establish the asymptotic distribution of the thresholding statistics in conjunction with the matrix blocking and the coupling techniques. It is shown that the proposed test is more powerful than the existing tests in detecting sparse and weak signals in covariances. Multiple testing procedures are constructed to discover different covariances and the sub-groups of variables with different covariance structures between the two populations. The proposed procedures are based on the multi-level thresholding test, which are able to control the false discovery proportion ( FDP ) with high power. Simulation experiments and a case study on the returns of the S&P 500 stocks before and after the COVID-19 pandemic are conducted to demonstrate and compare the utilities of the proposed methods.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考虑对来自两个边际次高斯分布总体的协方差矩阵进行检验和信号识别。提出了一种多级阈值化方法用于检验两个高维协方差矩阵的相等性，该方法旨在检测协方差之间的稀疏和微弱差异。结合矩阵分块和耦合技术，提出了一种新的U统计量组合，以建立阈值化统计量的渐近分布。结果表明，所提出的检验在检测协方差中的稀疏和弱信号方面比现有检验更有效。构建了多重检验方法，以发现两个总体之间不同的协方差以及具有不同协方差结构的变量子组。所提出的方法基于多级阈值化检验，能够以高功效控制错误发现比例（FDP）。进行了模拟实验以及关于COVID-19疫情前后S&P 500只股票收益的案例研究，以展示和比较所提出方法的效用。

articles.title_en: Penalized time-varying model averaging
articles.title_cn: 惩罚性时变模型平均
articles.abstract_en: This paper proposes a new penalized time-varying model averaging method to determine optimal time-varying combination weights for candidate models, which avoids over-fitting and yields sparseness from various potential predictive variables. The asymptotic optimality and convergence rate of the selected weights are derived even when all candidate models are misspecified, and the consistency and normality of the proposed time-varying model averaging estimator are obtained when the true model is included in the candidate models. Simulation studies and empirical applications to inflation forecasting highlight the merits of the proposed method.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一种新的惩罚性时变模型平均方法，用于确定候选模型的最优时变组合权重，该方法避免了过拟合，并从各种潜在预测变量中产生稀疏性。即使所有候选模型均被误设，所选权重的渐近最优性和收敛速率仍可推导得出；当真实模型包含在候选模型中时，所提出的时变模型平均估计量的一致性和正态性得以获得。模拟研究以及对通货膨胀预测的实证应用凸显了所提方法的优势。

articles.title_en: Time-varying unobserved heterogeneity in earnings shocks
articles.title_cn: 收入冲击中随时间变化的不可观测异质性
articles.abstract_en: This paper considers the transitory-permanent model for the earnings process, and allows for time-varying individual-specific unobserved heterogeneity in each shock. The cross-sectional heterogeneity in each shock is drawn from an unknown distribution at each time period. Sufficient conditions for the nonparametric identification of the cross-sectional density functions of the heterogeneity are provided, under different assumptions on the time series behavior of the transitory shock. The method proposed is then applied to earnings data to document a high degree of cross-sectional heterogeneity in each shock.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考虑收入过程的暂时性-永久性模型，并允许每个冲击中存在随时间变化的个体特定不可观测异质性。每个冲击中的横截面异质性在每个时间期从未知分布中抽取。在关于暂时性冲击时间序列行为的不同假设下，提供了异质性横截面密度函数非参数识别的充分条件。随后将所提出的方法应用于收入数据，以记录每个冲击中高度的横截面异质性。

articles.title_en: Intraday cross-sectional distributions of systematic risk
articles.title_cn: 系统性风险的日内横截面分布
articles.abstract_en: We develop a test for the detection of intraday changes in the cross-sectional distribution of assets’ exposure to observable factors. The test is constructed for a panel of high-frequency asset returns, with the size of the cross-section and the sampling frequency increasing simultaneously. It is based on a comparison of the empirical characteristic functions of estimates of the assets’ factor loadings at different parts of the trading day, formed from local blocks of asset returns and the corresponding factor realizations. The limiting behavior of the test statistic is governed by unobservable latent factors in the asset prices. The critical values of the test are constructed on the basis of a novel simulation-based procedure. Empirical implementation of the test to stocks in the S&P 500 index and the five Fama–French factors, as well as the momentum factor, reveals different intraday behavior of the factor loadings: assets’ exposure to size, market and value risks vary systematically over the trading day while the three remaining factors do not exhibit statistically significant intraday variation. Moreover, we find diverse, and for some factors large, reactions in the assets’ factor loadings to major economic or firm specific news releases. Finally, we document that time-varying correlations between the observable risk factors drive a wedge between the time-of-day pattern of market betas, estimated with and without control for the other observable risk factors.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一种检验，用于检测资产对可观测因子暴露的横截面分布的日内变化。该检验针对高频资产收益率面板构建，其中横截面规模和抽样频率同时增加。它基于对交易日不同时段资产因子载荷估计值的经验特征函数的比较，这些估计值由资产收益率的局部区块和相应的因子实现值形成。检验统计量的极限行为由资产价格中不可观测的潜在因子决定。检验的临界值基于一种新颖的基于模拟的程序构建。将该检验实证应用于S&P 500指数中的股票以及五个Fama–French因子和动量因子，揭示了因子载荷的不同日内行为：资产对规模、市场和价值风险的暴露在交易日内系统性变化，而其余三个因子则未表现出统计显著的日内变化。此外，我们发现资产因子载荷对重大经济或公司特定新闻发布存在多样化的反应，且对某些因子而言反应较大。最后，我们记录了可观测风险因子之间的时变相关性在控制和不控制其他可观测风险因子的情况下估计的市场贝塔的日内模式之间造成了楔子。

articles.title_en: Comparing stochastic volatility specifications for large Bayesian VARs
articles.title_cn: 比较大型贝叶斯VAR的随机波动率设定
articles.abstract_en: Large Bayesian vector autoregressions with various forms of stochastic volatility have become increasingly popular in empirical macroeconomics. One main difficulty for practitioners is to choose the most suitable stochastic volatility specification for their particular application. We develop Bayesian model comparison methods–based on marginal likelihood estimators that combine conditional Monte Carlo and adaptive importance sampling–to choose among a variety of stochastic volatility specifications. The proposed methods can also be used to select an appropriate shrinkage prior on the VAR coefficients, which is a critical component for avoiding over-fitting in high-dimensional settings. Using US quarterly data of different dimensions, we find that both the Cholesky stochastic volatility and factor stochastic volatility outperform the common stochastic volatility specification. Their superior performance, however, can mostly be attributed to the more flexible priors that accommodate cross-variable shrinkage.
articles.abstract_cn: 具有各种形式随机波动率的大型贝叶斯向量自回归在实证宏观经济学中越来越受欢迎。实践者的一个主要困难是为其特定应用选择最合适的随机波动率设定。我们开发了基于边际似然估计量的贝叶斯模型比较方法——这些估计量结合了条件蒙特卡洛和自适应重要性抽样——以在各种随机波动率设定中进行选择。所提出的方法也可用于为VAR系数选择合适的收缩先验，这是在高维设定中避免过度拟合的关键组成部分。使用不同维度的美国季度数据，我们发现Cholesky随机波动率和因子随机波动率均优于常见的随机波动率设定。然而，它们的优越表现主要可归因于更灵活的、能够适应跨变量收缩的先验。

articles.title_en: The distribution of rolling regression estimators
articles.title_cn: 滚动回归估计量的分布
articles.abstract_en: We establish the asymptotic distribution for rolling linear regression models using various window widths. The limiting distribution depends on the width of the rolling window and on a “bias process” that is typically ignored in practice. Based on the asymptotic distribution, we tabulate critical values used to find uniform confidence intervals for the average values of regression parameters over the windows. We propose a corrected rolling regression technique that removes the bias process by rolling over smoothed parameter estimates. The procedure is illustrated using a series of Monte Carlo experiments. The paper includes an empirical example to show how the confidence bands suggest alternative conclusions about the persistence of inflation.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们使用各种窗口宽度建立了滚动线性回归模型的渐近分布。极限分布取决于滚动窗口的宽度以及一个在实践中通常被忽略的“偏倚过程”。基于渐近分布，我们列出了用于寻找窗口内回归参数平均值的统一置信区间的临界值。我们提出了一种校正滚动回归技术，通过对平滑参数估计进行滚动来消除偏倚过程。该过程通过一系列蒙特卡洛实验进行了说明。本文包含一个实证例子，以展示置信带如何对通胀持续性提出替代性结论。

articles.title_en: Estimation and identification of latent group structures in panel data
articles.title_cn: 面板数据中潜在组结构的估计与识别
articles.abstract_en: This paper provides a framework for joint estimation and identification of latent group structures in panel data models using a pairwise fusion penalized approach. The latent structure of the model allows individuals to be classified into different groups where the number of groups and the group membership are unknown. The individuals within a group have common slope parameters, while parameter heterogeneity is allowed across the groups. A penalized least squares (PLS) approach is introduced for models with exogenous regressors. When the model contains endogenous regressors, a penalized generalized method of moment (PGMM) is introduced. To implement the proposed approach, an alternating direction method of multipliers algorithm has been developed. The proposed method is further illustrated by simulation studies which demonstrate the finite sample performance of the method, and is applied in an empirical analysis.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文提供了一个使用成对融合惩罚方法对面板数据模型中的潜在组结构进行联合估计与识别的框架。模型的潜在结构允许个体被分类到不同的组中，其中组的数量和组成员身份是未知的。组内的个体具有共同的斜率参数，而组间允许参数异质性。针对含有外生回归量的模型，引入了惩罚最小二乘（PLS）方法。当模型包含内生回归量时，引入了惩罚广义矩方法（PGMM）。为实施所提出的方法，开发了一种交替方向乘子算法。所提出的方法进一步通过模拟研究加以说明，这些模拟研究展示了该方法的有限样本性能，并将其应用于一项实证分析中。

articles.title_en: Parametric estimation of long memory in factor models
articles.title_cn: 因子模型中长记忆的参数估计
articles.abstract_en: A dynamic factor model is proposed in that factor dynamics are driven by stochastic time trends describing arbitrary persistence levels. The proposed model is essentially a long memory factor model, which nests standard I ( 0 ) and I ( 1 ) behavior smoothly in common factors. In the estimation, principal components analysis (PCA) and conditional sum of squares (CSS) estimations are employed. For the dynamic model parameters, centered normal asymptotics are established at the usual parametric rates, and their small-sample properties are explored via Monte-Carlo experiments. The method is then applied to a panel of U.S. industry realized volatilities.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文提出一个动态因子模型，其中因子动态由描述任意持久性水平的随机时间趋势驱动。所提出的模型本质上是一个长记忆因子模型，它在共同因子中平滑地嵌套了标准的 I(0) 和 I(1) 行为。在估计中，采用了主成分分析（PCA）和条件平方和（CSS）估计。对于动态模型参数，在通常的参数速率下建立了中心正态渐近性，并通过蒙特卡罗实验探讨了其小样本性质。随后将该方法应用于一组美国行业已实现波动率面板数据。

articles.title_en: Estimation and inference in factor copula models with exogenous covariates
articles.title_cn: 含外生协变量的因子Copula模型的估计与推断
articles.abstract_en: A factor copula model is proposed in which factors are either simulable or estimable from exogenous information. Point estimation and inference are based on a simulated methods of moments (SMM) approach with non-overlapping simulation draws. Consistency and limiting normality of the estimator is established and the validity of bootstrap standard errors is shown. Doing so, previous results from the literature are verified under low-level conditions imposed on the individual components of the factor structure. Monte Carlo evidence confirms the accuracy of the asymptotic theory in finite samples and an empirical application illustrates the usefulness of the model to explain the cross-sectional dependence between stock returns.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一种因子Copula模型，其中因子要么可模拟，要么可从外生信息中估计。点估计和推断基于具有非重叠模拟抽取的模拟矩方法（SMM）。建立了估计量的一致性和极限正态性，并证明了自助法标准误的有效性。在此过程中，文献中的先前结果在施加于因子结构各个成分的低层条件下得到验证。蒙特卡洛证据证实了渐近理论在有限样本中的准确性，一个实证应用说明了该模型在解释股票收益之间横截面依赖性方面的有用性。

articles.title_en: Dividend suspensions and cash flows during the Covid-19 pandemic: A dynamic econometric model
articles.title_cn: Covid-19疫情期间的股息暂停与现金流：一个动态计量经济模型
articles.abstract_en: Firms suspended dividend payments in unprecedented numbers in response to the outbreak of the Covid-19 pandemic. We develop a multivariate dynamic econometric model that allows dividend suspensions to affect the conditional mean, volatility, and jump probability of growth in daily industry-level dividends and demonstrate how the parameters of this model can be estimated using Bayesian Gibbs sampling methods. We find considerable heterogeneity across industries in the dynamics of daily dividend growth and the impact of dividend suspensions.
articles.abstract_cn: 为应对Covid-19疫情的爆发，暂停股息支付的公司数量达到了前所未有的水平。我们构建了一个多变量动态计量经济模型，该模型允许股息暂停影响行业层面每日股息增长的条件均值、波动率和跳跃概率，并展示了如何使用贝叶斯Gibbs抽样方法估计该模型的参数。我们发现，在每日股息增长的动态以及股息暂停的影响方面，各行业之间存在相当大的异质性。

articles.title_en: Joint inference based on Stein-type averaging estimators in the linear regression model
articles.title_cn: 线性回归模型中基于Stein型平均估计量的联合推断
articles.abstract_en: While averaging unrestricted with restricted estimators is known to reduce estimation risk, it is an open question whether this reduction in turn can improve inference. To analyze this question, we construct joint confidence regions centered at James–Stein averaging estimators in both homoskedastic and heteroskedastic linear regression models. These regions are asymptotically valid when the number of restrictions increases possibly proportionally with the sample size. When used for hypothesis testing, we show that suitable restrictions enhance power over the standard F -test. We study the practical implementation through simulations and an application to consumption-based asset pricing.
articles.abstract_cn: 虽然已知无约束估计量与约束估计量的平均可以降低估计风险，但这种降低能否进而改进推断仍是一个未决问题。为了分析这一问题，我们在同方差和异方差线性回归模型中构建了以James–Stein平均估计量为中心的联合置信域。当约束数量可能随样本量成比例增加时，这些置信域是渐近有效的。当用于假设检验时，我们表明适当的约束相对于标准F检验提高了功效。我们通过模拟和基于消费的资产定价应用研究了实际实现。

articles.title_en: A functional estimation approach to the first-price auction models
articles.title_cn: 第一价格拍卖模型的一种函数估计方法
articles.abstract_en: This paper introduces new methods of identification and estimation of the first-price sealed bid auction model and compares them with the previous existing ones. The first method of estimation allows us to estimate directly (through an iterative algorithm) the cumulative distribution function of the private values without estimating the private values beforehand. In the second method, we use a quantile approach. Although the first-price auction is a complex nonlinear inverse problem, the use of quantile leads to a linearization of the model. Thus, in contrast with the existing methods we are able to deduce a closed-form solution for the quantile of the private values. This constructive identification allows for a one-stage estimation procedure that can be performed using three regularization methods: the Tikhonov regularization, the Landweber–Friedman regularization and the kernels. We conduct a Monte Carlo experiment to compare our methods of estimation by c.d.f. and quantiles with the methods of estimation developed by Guerre et al. (2000), Marmer and Shneyerov (2012), and Hickman and Hubbard (2015). Some extensions of the model are considered: asymmetric bidders, affiliation, conditional models to exogenuous variables, and the observation of only the winning bids.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文引入了第一价格密封投标拍卖模型识别与估计的新方法，并将其与已有的方法进行比较。第一种估计方法允许我们直接（通过迭代算法）估计私人价值的累积分布函数，而无需事先估计私人价值。在第二种方法中，我们使用分位数方法。尽管第一价格拍卖是一个复杂的非线性反问题，但使用分位数可使模型线性化。因此，与现有方法相比，我们能够推导出私人价值分位数的闭式解。这种构造性识别允许采用一步估计程序，该程序可使用三种正则化方法进行：Tikhonov正则化、Landweber–Friedman正则化和核方法。我们进行了一项蒙特卡洛实验，以通过累积分布函数和分位数将我们的估计方法与Guerre et al.（2000）、Marmer and Shneyerov（2012）以及Hickman and Hubbard（2015）开发的估计方法进行比较。考虑了模型的一些扩展：非对称投标人、关联性、以外生变量为条件的模型，以及仅观察到获胜出价。

articles.title_en: Identifying causal effects in experiments with spillovers and non-compliance
articles.title_cn: 识别具有溢出效应和不依从性的实验中的因果效应
articles.abstract_en: This paper shows how to use a randomized saturation experimental design to identify and estimate causal effects in the presence of spillovers–one person’s treatment may affect another’s outcome–and one-sided non-compliance—subjects can only be offered treatment, not compelled to take it up. Two distinct causal effects are of interest in this setting: direct effects quantify how a person’s own treatment changes her outcome, while indirect effects quantify how her peers’ treatments change her outcome. We consider the case in which spillovers occur within known groups, and take-up decisions are invariant to peers’ realized offers. In this setting we point identify the effects of treatment-on-the-treated, both direct and indirect, in a flexible random coefficients model that allows for heterogeneous treatment effects and endogenous selection into treatment. We go on to propose a feasible estimator that is consistent and asymptotically normal as the number and size of groups increases. We apply our estimator to data from a large-scale job placement services experiment, and find negative indirect treatment effects on the likelihood of employment for those willing to take up the program. These negative spillovers are offset by positive direct treatment effects from own take-up.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文展示了如何使用随机饱和实验设计来识别和估计存在溢出效应——一个人的处理可能影响另一个人的结果——和单侧不依从性——受试者只能被提供处理，而不能被强制接受处理——时的因果效应。在这种设定下，有两种不同的因果效应值得关注：直接效应量化一个人自身的处理如何改变其结果，而间接效应量化其同伴的处理如何改变其结果。我们考虑溢出效应发生在已知组内，且接受处理的决策不受同伴实际获得的提供影响的情况。在这种设定下，我们在一个灵活的随机系数模型中点识别了处理对接受处理者的效应，包括直接和间接效应，该模型允许异质性处理效应和内生选择进入处理。我们进一步提出了一个可行估计量，当组的数量和规模增加时，该估计量是一致的且渐近正态的。我们将我们的估计量应用于一个大规模就业安置服务实验的数据，发现对愿意接受该项目的人而言，就业可能性存在负向间接处理效应。这些负向溢出效应被来自自身接受处理的正向直接处理效应所抵消。

articles.title_en: Instrument strength in IV estimation and inference: A guide to theory and practice
articles.title_cn: IV估计与推断中的工具强度：理论与实践指南
articles.abstract_en: Two stage least squares (2SLS) has poor properties if instruments are exogenous but weak. But how strong do instruments need to be for 2SLS estimates and test statistics to exhibit acceptable properties? A common standard is that first-stage F ≥ 10 . This is adequate to ensure two-tailed t -tests have modest size distortions. But other problems persist: In particular, we show 2SLS standard errors are artificially small in samples where the estimate is most contaminated by the OLS bias. Hence, if the bias is positive, the t -test has little power to detect true negative effects, and inflated power to find positive effects. This phenomenon, which we call a “power asymmetry,” persists even if first-stage F is in the thousands. Robust tests like Anderson–Rubin perform better, and should be used in lieu of the t -test even with strong instruments. We also show how 2SLS test statistics typically suffer from very low power if first-stage F is only 10, leading us to suggest a higher standard of instrument strength in empirical practice.
articles.abstract_cn: 如果工具是外生的但较弱，两阶段最小二乘法（2SLS）的性质较差。但工具需要多强，2SLS估计量和检验统计量才能表现出可接受的性质？一个常见标准是第一阶段的F ≥ 10。这足以确保双尾t检验具有适度的规模扭曲。但其他问题仍然存在：特别是，我们表明，在估计量受OLS偏误污染最严重的样本中，2SLS标准误被人为地缩小。因此，如果偏误为正，t检验几乎没有功效检测出真实的负效应，而发现正效应的功效则被夸大。这种现象，我们称之为“功效不对称”，即使第一阶段的F在数千的量级上仍然存在。像Anderson–Rubin这样的稳健检验表现更好，即使工具很强，也应使用它们代替t检验。我们还表明，如果第一阶段的F仅为10，2SLS检验统计量通常功效极低，这使我们在实证实践中建议采用更高的工具强度标准。
