articles.title_en: Binary response models for heterogeneous panel data with interactive fixed effects
articles.title_cn: 具有交互固定效应的异质性面板数据的二元响应模型
articles.abstract_en: In this paper, we investigate binary response models for heterogeneous panel data with interactive fixed effects by allowing both the cross-sectional dimension and the temporal dimension to diverge. From a practical point of view, the proposed framework can be applied to predict the probability of corporate failure, conduct credit rating analysis, etc. Theoretically and methodologically, we build a link between a maximum likelihood estimation and a least squares approach, provide a simple information criterion to detect the number of factors, and establish the corresponding asymptotic theory. In addition, we conduct intensive simulations to examine the theoretical findings. In an empirical study, we focus on the sign prediction of stock returns, and then use the results of sign forecast to conduct portfolio analysis.
articles.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们通过允许横截面维度和时间维度同时发散，研究了具有交互固定效应的异质性面板数据的二元响应模型。从实践角度来看，所提出的框架可应用于预测公司失败的概率、进行信用评级分析等。在理论和方法上，我们在最大似然估计与最小二乘方法之间建立了联系，提供了一个简单的信息准则来检测因子个数，并建立了相应的渐近理论。此外，我们进行了大量模拟以检验理论发现。在一项实证研究中，我们关注股票收益的符号预测，然后利用符号预测的结果进行投资组合分析。

articles.title_en: Uniform inference for value functions
articles.title_cn: 值函数的统一推断
articles.abstract_en: We propose a method to conduct uniform inference for the (optimal) value function, that is, the function that results from optimizing an objective function marginally over one of its arguments. Marginal optimization is not Hadamard differentiable (that is, compactly differentiable) as a map between the spaces of objective and value functions, which is problematic because standard inference methods for nonlinear maps usually rely on Hadamard differentiability. However, we show that the map from objective function to an L p functional of a value function, for 1 ≤ p ≤ ∞ , are Hadamard directionally differentiable. As a result, we establish consistency and weak convergence of nonparametric plug-in estimates of Cramér–von Mises and Kolmogorov–Smirnov test statistics applied to value functions. For practical inference, we develop detailed resampling techniques that combine a bootstrap procedure with estimates of the directional derivatives. In addition, we establish local and uniform size control of one-sided tests which use the resampling procedure. Monte Carlo simulations assess the finite-sample properties of the proposed methods and show accurate empirical size and nontrivial power of the procedures. Finally, we apply our methods to the evaluation of a job training program using bounds for the distribution function of treatment effects.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出一种对（最优）值函数进行统一推断的方法，即对目标函数关于其某个自变量进行边际优化后得到的函数。边际优化作为目标函数空间与值函数空间之间的映射，并非 Hadamard 可微（即紧可微），这带来了问题，因为非线性映射的标准推断方法通常依赖于 Hadamard 可微性。然而，我们证明，从目标函数到值函数的 L p 泛函的映射，对于 1 ≤ p ≤ ∞，是 Hadamard 方向可微的。因此，我们建立了应用于值函数的 Cramér–von Mises 和 Kolmogorov–Smirnov 检验统计量的非参数插入估计的一致性和弱收敛性。对于实际推断，我们开发了详细的再抽样技术，将自助法与方向导数的估计相结合。此外，我们建立了使用该再抽样程序的单侧检验的局部和统一水平控制。蒙特卡洛模拟评估了所提方法的有限样本性质，并显示了程序准确的经验水平和非平凡功效。最后，我们将我们的方法应用于一个职业培训项目的评估，使用处理效应分布函数的界。

articles.title_en: IV methods for Tobit models
articles.title_cn: Tobit模型的IV方法
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies models of processes generating censored outcomes with endogenous explanatory variables and instrumental variable restrictions. Tobit-type left censoring at zero is the primary focus in the exposition. Extension to stochastic censoring is sketched. The models do not specify the process determining endogenous explanatory variables and they do not embody restrictions justifying control function approaches. Consequently, they can be partially or point identifying. Identified sets are characterized and it is shown how inference can be performed on scalar functions of partially identified parameters when exogenous variables have rich support. In an application using data on UK household tobacco expenditures inference is conducted on the coefficient of an endogenous total expenditure variable with and without a Gaussian distributional restriction on the unobservable and compared with the results obtained using a point identifying complete triangular model.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究具有内生解释变量和工具变量限制的、生成删失结果的过程的模型。阐述中主要关注在零处的Tobit型左删失。概述了对随机删失的扩展。这些模型没有指定决定内生解释变量的过程，也没有包含为控制函数方法提供正当性的限制。因此，它们可以是部分识别或点识别的。刻画了识别集，并表明当外生变量具有丰富支撑时，如何对部分识别参数的标量函数进行推断。在一项使用英国住户烟草支出数据的应用中，对内生总支出变量的系数进行了推断，分别在有和没有对不可观测项的高斯分布限制的情况下，并与使用点识别完全三角模型得到的结果进行了比较。

articles.title_en: Debiased machine learning of set-identified linear models
articles.title_cn: 集合识别线性模型的双重稳健机器学习
articles.abstract_en: This paper provides estimation and inference methods for an identified set’s boundary (i.e., support function) where the selection among a very large number of covariates is based on modern regularized tools. I characterize the boundary using a semiparametric moment equation. Combining Neyman-orthogonality and sample splitting ideas, I construct a root- N consistent, uniformly asymptotically Gaussian estimator of the boundary and propose a multiplier bootstrap procedure to conduct inference. I apply this result to the Partially Linear Model, the Partially Linear IV Model and the Average Partial Derivative with an interval-valued outcome.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文提供了识别集边界（即支撑函数）的估计和推断方法，其中大量协变量的选择基于现代正则化工具。我使用半参数矩方程来刻画边界。结合Neyman正交性和样本分割思想，我构建了边界的根号N一致、一致渐近高斯估计量，并提出了一种乘子自助法程序来进行推断。我将这一结果应用于部分线性模型、部分线性IV模型以及具有区间值结果的平均偏导数。

articles.title_en: Jackknife estimation of a cluster-sample IV regression model with many weak instruments
articles.title_cn: 具有许多弱工具的聚类样本IV回归模型的刀切估计
articles.abstract_en: This paper proposes new jackknife IV estimators that are robust to the effects of many weak instruments and error heteroskedasticity in a cluster sample setting with cluster-specific effects and possibly many included exogenous regressors. The estimators that we propose are designed to properly partial out the cluster-specific effects and included exogenous regressors while preserving the re-centering property of the jackknife methodology. To the best of our knowledge, our proposed procedures provide the first consistent estimators under many weak instrument asymptotics in the setting considered. We also present results on the asymptotic normality of our estimators and show that t-statistics based on said estimators are asymptotically normal under the null and consistent under fixed alternatives. Monte Carlo results show that our t-statistics perform better in controlling size in finite samples than those based on alternative jackknife IV procedures previously introduced in the literature.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文提出了新的刀切IV估计量，这些估计量在具有聚类特定效应和可能包含许多外生回归量的聚类样本环境中，对许多弱工具和误差异方差性的影响具有稳健性。我们提出的估计量旨在适当地分离出聚类特定效应和所包含的外生回归量，同时保持刀切方法的重新中心化性质。据我们所知，我们提出的程序在所考虑的环境中，提供了许多弱工具渐近下首批一致的估计量。我们还给出了估计量渐近正态性的结果，并表明基于上述估计量的t统计量在原假设下渐近正态，在固定备择假设下一致。蒙特卡洛结果表明，与文献中先前引入的替代刀切IV程序相比，我们的t统计量在有限样本中控制规模方面表现更好。

articles.title_en: Spatial autoregressions with an extended parameter space and similarity-based weights
articles.title_cn: 具有扩展参数空间和基于相似性的权重的空间自回归
articles.abstract_en: We provide in this paper asymptotic theory for a spatial autoregressive model (SAR, henceforth) in which the spatial coefficient, λ , is allowed to be less than or equal to unity, as well as consistent with a local to unit root (LUR) model and of the moderate integration (MI) from unity type, and the spatial weights are allowed to be similarity-based and data driven. Other special cases of our setting include the random walk, a model in which all the weights are equal, the standard SAR model in which λ < 1 and the similarity based autoregression in which λ = 1 and data do not display a natural order. As the norming rates for the asymptotic theory are very different in the λ < 1 - compared with the λ = 1 and LUR cases, we resort to random norming that treats all cases in a uniform manner. It turns out that standard CLT results prevail in a large class of models in which the infinity norm of the inverse of the weighting structure that characterizes the reduced-form process is O n γ , γ ∈ [ 0 , 1 ) , and is non-standard in the case γ = 1 . We use a shifted profile likelihood to obtain results which are valid for all cases. A small simulation experiment supports our findings and the usefulness of our model is illustrated with an empirical application of the Boston housing data set in which the estimate of λ appeared to be very close to unity.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们在本文中提供了空间自回归模型（SAR，下文）的渐近理论，其中空间系数 λ 允许小于或等于统一，并且与局部到单位根（LUR）模型和统一类型的适度积分（MI）一致，并且空间权重允许基于相似性和数据驱动。我们设置的其他特殊情况包括随机游走（所有权重都相等的模型）、标准 SAR 模型（其中 λ < 1）以及基于相似性的自回归（其中 λ = 1 且数据不显示自然顺序）。由于渐进理论的规范率在 λ < 1 中与 λ = 1 和 LUR 情况相比非常不同，因此我们采用随机规范，以统一的方式处理所有情况。事实证明，标准 CLT 结果在一大类模型中占主导地位，其中表征简化形式过程的权重结构逆的无穷大范数为 O n γ , γ ∈ [ 0 , 1 ) ，并且在 γ = 1 的情况下是非标准的。我们使用转移的轮廓可能性来获得对所有情况都有效的结果。一个小型模拟实验支持了我们的发现，并且我们的模型的有用性通过波士顿住房数据集的实证应用来说明，其中 λ 的估计值似乎非常接近统一。

articles.title_en: Wild bootstrap inference for penalized quantile regression for longitudinal data
articles.title_cn: 纵向数据惩罚分位数回归的野自助法推断
articles.abstract_en: The existing theory of penalized quantile regression for longitudinal data has focused primarily on point estimation. In this work, we investigate statistical inference. We propose a wild residual bootstrap procedure and show that it is asymptotically valid for approximating the distribution of the penalized estimator. The model puts no restrictions on individual effects, and the estimator achieves consistency by letting the shrinkage decay in importance asymptotically. The new method is easy to implement and simulation studies show that it has accurate small sample behavior in comparison with existing procedures. Finally, we illustrate the new approach using U.S. Census data to estimate a model that includes more than eighty thousand parameters.
articles.abstract_cn: 现有的纵向数据惩罚分位数回归理论主要关注点估计。在本研究中，我们探讨统计推断。我们提出一种野残差自助法程序，并证明其在逼近惩罚估计量分布方面是渐近有效的。该模型对个体效应不作任何限制，并且通过让收缩在渐近意义上重要性衰减，估计量达到一致性。新方法易于实施，模拟研究表明，与现有程序相比，它具有准确的小样本行为。最后，我们使用美国人口普查数据来估计一个包含超过八万个参数的模型，以说明这种新方法。

articles.title_en: Refining set-identification in VARs through independence
articles.title_cn: 通过独立性改进VARs中的集合识别
articles.abstract_en: Identification in VARs has traditionally mainly relied on second moments. Some researchers have considered using higher moments as well, but there are concerns about the strength of the identification obtained in this way. In this paper, we propose refining existing identification schemes by augmenting sign restrictions with a requirement that rules out shocks whose higher moments significantly depart from independence. This approach does not assume that higher moments help with identification; it is robust to weak identification. In simulations we show that it controls coverage well, in contrast to approaches that assume that the higher moments deliver point-identification. However, it requires large sample sizes and/or considerable non-normality to reduce the width of confidence intervals by much. We consider some empirical applications. We find that it can reject many possible rotations. The resulting confidence sets for impulse responses may be non-convex, corresponding to disjoint parts of the space of rotation matrices. We show that in this case, augmenting sign and magnitude restrictions with an independence requirement can yield bigger gains.
articles.abstract_cn: VARs中的识别传统上主要依赖二阶矩。一些研究者也考虑使用更高阶矩，但担心以这种方式获得的识别强度。在本文中，我们提出通过增加一个要求来改进现有的识别方案，该要求排除其更高阶矩显著偏离独立性的冲击。这种方法不假设更高阶矩有助于识别；它对弱识别是稳健的。在模拟中，我们表明它能很好地控制覆盖率，与假设更高阶矩提供点识别的方法形成对比。然而，它需要大样本量和/或相当大的非正态性才能大幅缩小置信区间的宽度。我们考虑了一些实证应用。我们发现它可以拒绝许多可能的旋转。脉冲响应的结果置信集可能非凸，对应于旋转矩阵空间的不相交部分。我们表明，在这种情况下，用独立性要求增强符号和幅度限制可以产生更大的收益。

articles.title_en: Efficient estimation of average derivatives in NPIV models: Simulation comparisons of neural network estimators
articles.title_cn: NPIV模型中平均导数的高效估计：神经网络估计量的模拟比较
articles.abstract_en: Artificial Neural Networks (ANNs) can be viewed as nonlinear sieves that can approximate complex functions of high dimensional variables more effectively than linear sieves. We investigate the performance of various ANNs in nonparametric instrumental variables (NPIV) models of moderately high dimensional covariates that are relevant to empirical economics. We present two efficient procedures for estimation and inference on a weighted average derivative (WAD): an orthogonalized plug-in with optimally-weighted sieve minimum distance (OP-OSMD) procedure and a sieve efficient score (ES) procedure. Both estimators for WAD use ANN sieves to approximate the unknown NPIV function and are n -asymptotically normal and first-order equivalent. We provide a detailed practitioner’s recipe for implementing both efficient procedures. We compare their finite-sample performances in various simulation designs that involve smooth NPIV function of up to 13 continuous covariates, different nonlinearities and covariate correlations. Some Monte Carlo findings include: (1) tuning and optimization are more delicate in ANN estimation; (2) given proper tuning, both ANN estimators with various architectures can perform well; (3) easier to tune ANN OP-OSMD estimators than ANN ES estimators; (4) stable inferences are more difficult to achieve with ANN (than spline) estimators; (5) there are gaps between current implementations and approximation theories. Finally, we apply ANN NPIV to estimate average partial derivatives in two empirical demand examples with multivariate covariates.
articles.abstract_cn: 人工神经网络（ANNs）可被视为非线性筛，能够比线性筛更有效地逼近高维变量的复杂函数。我们考察了各种ANN在中等高维协变量的非参数工具变量（NPIV）模型中的表现，这些模型与实证经济学相关。我们提出了两种用于加权平均导数（WAD）估计和推断的高效程序：一种正交化插入结合最优加权筛最小距离（OP-OSMD）程序，以及一种筛有效得分（ES）程序。两种WAD估计量均使用ANN筛来逼近未知的NPIV函数，并且是n-渐近正态且一阶等价的。我们提供了实施这两种高效程序的详细实践者指南。我们在各种模拟设计中比较了它们的有限样本表现，这些设计涉及最多13个连续协变量的平滑NPIV函数、不同的非线性和协变量相关性。一些蒙特卡洛发现包括：（1）ANN估计中的调参和优化更为精细；（2）在适当调参下，各种架构的ANN估计量都能表现良好；（3）ANN OP-OSMD估计量比ANN ES估计量更容易调参；（4）ANN（相比样条）估计量更难实现稳定的推断；（5）当前实现与逼近理论之间存在差距。最后，我们将ANN NPIV应用于两个具有多变量协变量的实证需求例子中估计平均偏导数。

articles.title_en: Shrinkage estimation of multiple threshold factor models
articles.title_cn: 多重阈值因子模型的收缩估计
articles.abstract_en: This paper proposes a multiple threshold factor model to enhance the flexibility in modeling the underlying regime switching mechanism for high dimensional time series. The factor loadings are assumed to switch between different regimes according to the value of a threshold variable. A novel estimation procedure is proposed to consistently estimate the multiple thresholds with the aid of sorting operation, principal component analysis and shrinkage estimation, which is practically easy-to-implement and computationally efficient. Furthermore, asymptotic properties for the multiple threshold estimators are established, together with other theoretical results. Monte Carlo simulations demonstrate that the procedure works well in finite samples. The U.S. data sets are analyzed with the proposed model to illustrate the threshold effect of economy policy uncertainty on the financial market.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文提出一个多重阈值因子模型，以增强高维时间序列中潜在机制转换建模的灵活性。因子载荷被假定根据阈值变量的值在不同机制之间切换。本文提出一种新颖的估计程序，借助排序操作、主成分分析和收缩估计来一致地估计多重阈值，该程序在实践中易于实现且计算高效。此外，建立了多重阈值估计量的渐近性质，以及其他理论结果。蒙特卡洛模拟表明，该程序在有限样本中表现良好。使用所提出的模型对美国数据集进行分析，以说明经济政策不确定性对金融市场的阈值效应。

articles.title_en: Approximate factor models with weaker loadings
articles.title_cn: 具有较弱载荷的近似因子模型
articles.abstract_en: Pervasive cross-section dependence is increasingly recognized as a characteristic of economic data and the approximate factor model provides a useful framework for analysis. Assuming a strong factor structure where Λ 0 ′ Λ 0 / N α is positive definite in the limit when α = 1 , early work established convergence of the principal component estimates of the factors and loadings up to a rotation matrix. This paper shows that the estimates are still consistent and asymptotically normal when α ∈ ( 0 , 1 ] albeit at slower rates and under additional assumptions on the sample size. The results hold whether α is constant or varies across factor loadings. The framework developed for heterogeneous loadings and the simplified proofs that can be also used in strong factor analysis are of independent interest.
articles.abstract_cn: 普遍存在的截面相依性日益被视为经济数据的一个特征，而近似因子模型为分析提供了一个有用的框架。假设强因子结构，其中当 α = 1 时，Λ 0 ′ Λ 0 / N α 在极限下为正定，早期研究确立了因子和载荷的主成分估计在旋转矩阵意义下的收敛性。本文表明，当 α ∈ ( 0 , 1 ] 时，尽管收敛速度较慢且需要对样本量施加额外假设，这些估计仍然是一致的且渐近正态。无论 α 是常数还是随因子载荷变化，结果均成立。为异质载荷所开发的框架以及也可用于强因子分析的简化证明具有独立的研究价值。

articles.title_en: Large volatility matrix analysis using global and national factor models
articles.title_cn: 使用全球和国家因子模型的大波动率矩阵分析
articles.abstract_en: Several large volatility matrix inference procedures have been developed, based on the latent factor model. They often assumed that there are a few of common factors, which can account for volatility dynamics. However, several studies have demonstrated the presence of local factors. In particular, when analyzing the global stock market, we often observe that nation-specific factors explain their own country’s volatility dynamics. To account for this, we propose the Double Principal Orthogonal complEment Thresholding (Double-POET) method, based on multi-level factor models, and also establish its asymptotic properties. Furthermore, we demonstrate the drawback of using the regular principal orthogonal component thresholding (POET) when the local factor structure exists. We also describe the blessing of dimensionality using Double-POET for local covariance matrix estimation. Finally, we investigate the performance of the Double-POET estimator in an out-of-sample portfolio allocation study using international stocks from 20 financial markets.
articles.abstract_cn: 基于潜在因子模型，已经开发了几种大波动率矩阵推断方法。它们通常假设存在少数共同因子，这些因子可以解释波动率动态。然而，多项研究已经证明了局部因子的存在。特别是，在分析全球股票市场时，我们经常观察到国家特定因子解释其本国波动率动态。为了解决这个问题，我们基于多级因子模型提出了双主正交补阈值化（Double-POET）方法，并建立了其渐近性质。此外，我们展示了当局部因子结构存在时，使用常规主正交成分阈值化（POET）的缺点。我们还描述了使用Double-POET进行局部协方差矩阵估计的维数祝福。最后，我们使用来自20个金融市场的国际股票，在样本外投资组合分配研究中调查了Double-POET估计器的性能。

articles.title_en: Uniform and convergences for nonparametric continuous time regressions with semiparametric applications
articles.title_cn: 非参数连续时间回归的一致性与收敛性及其半参数应用
articles.abstract_en: We obtain uniform and L p convergence rates of kernel type nonparametric estimators for the instantaneous conditional mean and variance functions of continuous time regressions, where the regressor is assumed to be a general recurrent diffusion. Our asymptotics are developed under a general set-up, with a shrinking sampling interval and an increasing time span, and without the stationarity assumption. Based on our convergence results, we develop a semiparametric inferential procedure for continuous time predictive regressions. In particular, a robust semiparametric likelihood ratio test for linear predictability is proposed, with its limit distribution established. We also apply our convergence results to obtain the asymptotics of a semiparametric maximum likelihood estimator of the drift of recurrent diffusions. In our simulation study, we examine the finite sample performance of our robust test against several existing tests in the literature. An empirical illustration is presented to test the predictability of the excess returns of two major stock indices using the commonly used dividend–price ratio and earnings–price ratio as the predictor.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们获得了连续时间回归的瞬时条件均值函数和方差函数的核型非参数估计量的一致收敛速率和 L p 收敛速率，其中回归量被假定为一般递归扩散过程。我们的渐近理论是在一般设定下发展的，具有收缩的采样区间和增加的时间跨度，并且不依赖于平稳性假设。基于我们的收敛结果，我们为连续时间预测回归开发了一种半参数推断程序。特别地，我们提出了一种针对线性可预测性的稳健半参数似然比检验，并建立了其极限分布。我们还应用我们的收敛结果来获得递归扩散过程漂移的半参数最大似然估计量的渐近性质。在我们的模拟研究中，我们检验了我们的稳健检验相对于文献中几种现有检验的有限样本表现。我们提供了一个实证例证，使用常用的股息价格比和盈利价格比作为预测变量，来检验两个主要股票指数的超额收益的可预测性。

articles.title_en: Identifying latent group structures in spatial dynamic panels
articles.title_cn: 空间动态面板中潜在组结构的识别
articles.abstract_en: This paper considers the identification of latent group structures in spatial dynamic panels. We follow Lee and Yu (2010) and consider a rich spatial dynamic panel data (SDPD) model with two-way fixed effects. In addition, we also allow for latent panel structures where individuals can be classified into a few groups such that individuals within the same group share the common slope parameters and do not otherwise. Both the number of groups and the individuals’ group membership are unknown. To identify the latent group structures, we first adopt the GMM to obtain the preliminary unconstrained estimates of the slope coefficients. Then we apply the sequential binary segmentation algorithm (SBSA) of Wang and Su (2021) to these estimates and obtain the clusters. A BIC-type information criterion is proposed to choose the number of latent groups consistently. The asymptotic analysis shows that this method can identify the true group structure consistently, and the post-classification estimators enjoy the oracle property. Monte Carlo simulations demonstrate that our method has good finite sample performance. Finally, we apply our approach to the US housing market and identify two latent Metropolitan Statistical Areas groups.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考虑空间动态面板中潜在组结构的识别。我们遵循Lee和Yu（2010）的做法，考虑一个具有双向固定效应的丰富空间动态面板数据（SDPD）模型。此外，我们还允许存在潜在面板结构，其中个体可以被分类为少数几个组，使得同一组内的个体共享共同的斜率参数，否则不共享。组的数量和个体的组归属都是未知的。为了识别潜在组结构，我们首先采用GMM获得斜率系数的初步无约束估计。然后，我们将Wang和Su（2021）的序贯二元分割算法（SBSA）应用于这些估计，并获得聚类。提出了一种BIC型信息准则以一致地选择潜在组的数量。渐近分析表明，该方法能够一致地识别真实的组结构，并且分类后估计量具有oracle性质。蒙特卡洛模拟表明，我们的方法具有良好的有限样本性能。最后，我们将我们的方法应用于美国住房市场，并识别出两个潜在的都市统计区组。

articles.title_en: One-way or two-way factor model for matrix sequences?
articles.title_cn: 矩阵序列的单向或双向因子模型？
articles.abstract_en: This paper investigates the issue of determining the dimensions of row and column factor spaces in matrix-valued data. Exploiting the eigen-gap in the spectrum of sample second moment matrices of the data, we propose a family of randomised tests to check whether a one-way or two-way factor structure exists or not. Our tests do not require any arbitrary thresholding on the eigenvalues, and can be applied with (virtually) no restrictions on the relative rate of divergence of the cross-sections to the sample sizes as they pass to infinity. Although tests are based on a randomisation which does not vanish asymptotically, we propose a de-randomised, “strong” (based on the Law of the Iterated Logarithm) decision rule to choose in favour or against the presence of common factors. We use the proposed tests and decision rule in two ways. We further cast our individual tests in a sequential procedure whose output is an estimate of the number of common factors. Our tests are built on two variants of the sample second moment matrix of the data: one based on a row (or column) “flattened” version of the matrix-valued sequence, and one based on a projection-based method. Our simulations show that both procedures work well in large samples and, in small samples, the one based on the projection method delivers a superior performance compared to existing methods in virtually all cases considered.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了确定矩阵值数据中行和列因子空间维度的问题。利用数据样本二阶矩矩阵谱中的特征间隙，我们提出了一族随机化检验，以检验是否存在单向或双向因子结构。我们的检验不需要对特征值进行任何任意阈值处理，并且几乎可以在横截面与样本量趋于无穷时的相对发散率上没有任何限制地应用。尽管检验基于一种不会渐近消失的随机化，我们提出了一种去随机化的、“强”的（基于重对数律）决策规则，以选择支持或反对共同因子的存在。我们以两种方式使用所提出的检验和决策规则。我们进一步将我们的个体检验置于一个序贯程序中，其输出是共同因子数量的估计。我们的检验建立在数据样本二阶矩矩阵的两种变体上：一种基于矩阵值序列的行（或列）“展平”版本，另一种基于投影方法。我们的模拟表明，两种程序在大样本中表现良好，而在小样本中，基于投影方法的程序在几乎所有考虑的情况下都优于现有方法。

articles.title_en: Wald, QLR, and score tests when parameters are subject to linear inequality constraints
articles.title_cn: 当参数受到线性不等式约束时的Wald、QLR和score检验
articles.abstract_en: This paper develops Wald-type, QLR, and score-type tests for linear equality constraints in a general class of extremum estimation problems where the parameter space is characterized by a finite number of linear equality and inequality constraints. We show that the asymptotic null distributions of the Wald and QLR statistics are discontinuous in an implicit nuisance parameter and propose an algorithm to identify it. In contrast, the asymptotic null distribution of the score statistic is not discontinuous in any model parameter but depends on a polytope projection. We present an algorithm based on the Fourier–Motzkin elimination to compute such a projection. We study the consistency and local power properties of the three tests. Finally, we present numerical results of our tests’ finite sample performance from a Monte Carlo study and conduct an empirical illustration of a Mincer earnings regression.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文针对一类一般的极值估计问题，其中参数空间由有限数量的线性等式和不等式约束刻画，发展了用于线性等式约束的Wald型、QLR和score型检验。我们证明，Wald和QLR统计量的渐近零分布对一个隐含的冗余参数是不连续的，并提出了一种识别该参数的算法。相比之下，score统计量的渐近零分布对任何模型参数都不存在不连续性，而是依赖于一个多面体投影。我们提出了一种基于Fourier–Motzkin消元法来计算此类投影的算法。我们研究了这三种检验的一致性和局部功效性质。最后，我们展示了来自蒙特卡洛研究的关于我们检验有限样本表现的数值结果，并对一个Mincer earnings回归进行了实证说明。

articles.title_en: Testing for the appropriate level of clustering in linear regression models
articles.title_cn: 线性回归模型中适当聚类水平的检验
articles.abstract_en: The overwhelming majority of empirical research that uses cluster-robust inference assumes that the clustering structure is known, even though there are often several possible ways in which a dataset could be clustered. We propose two tests for the correct level of clustering in regression models. One test focuses on inference about a single coefficient, and the other on inference about two or more coefficients. We provide both asymptotic and wild bootstrap implementations. The proposed tests work for a null hypothesis of either no clustering or “fine” clustering against alternatives of “coarser” clustering. We also propose a sequential testing procedure to determine the appropriate level of clustering. Simulations suggest that the bootstrap tests perform very well under the null hypothesis and can have excellent power. An empirical example suggests that using the tests leads to sensible inferences.
articles.abstract_cn: 绝大多数使用聚类稳健推断的实证研究都假设聚类结构是已知的，尽管数据集往往有几种可能的聚类方式。我们提出了两种检验回归模型中正确聚类水平的方法。一种检验侧重于对单个系数的推断，另一种侧重于对两个或多个系数的推断。我们提供了渐近和野自助法两种实现方式。所提出的检验适用于原假设为无聚类或“细”聚类，备择假设为“粗”聚类的情形。我们还提出了一个序贯检验程序以确定适当的聚类水平。模拟表明，自助法检验在原假设下表现非常好，并且可以具有极好的功效。一个实证例子表明，使用这些检验可得出合理的推断。

articles.title_en: Social threshold regression
articles.title_cn: 社会阈值回归
articles.abstract_en: This paper develops a threshold social interaction model which introduces group-specific endogenous effects as well as contextual effects into a conventional spatial Durbin model. We propose a two-step GMM estimator for the threshold and regression parameters, derive asymptotic theory, and provide bootstrap inference. Finally, we assess the performance of our methods using a Monte Carlo simulation and provide an empirical application on the role of peer effects on student academic achievement using Add Health data.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文构建了一个阈值社会互动模型，该模型将组别特定的内生效应以及情境效应引入传统的空间杜宾模型。我们提出了阈值参数和回归参数的两步GMM估计量，推导了渐近理论，并提供了自助法推断。最后，我们使用蒙特卡洛模拟评估了我们的方法的性能，并基于Add Health数据提供了一个关于同伴效应对学生学业成绩作用的实证应用。

articles.title_en: Stochastic properties of nonlinear locally-nonstationary filters
articles.title_cn: 非线性局部非平稳滤波器的随机性质
articles.abstract_en: This article delivers conditions for the existence of a unique stationary, ergodic and φ -mixing invertible solution for nonlinear time-varying parameter models that are locally non-stationary or explosive. The assumptions are different from existing conditions as they do not impose Lipschitz, bounded growth or drift restrictions. Instead we require that the time series contains resetting dynamics. These dynamics are present in time series with sudden changes, such as stock prices with financial bubbles. We explain how our results can be applied to multiple models with time-varying conditional mean and time-varying conditional variance. Additionally, we show the empirical relevance of locally non-stationary models by developing a robust score-driven locally-nonstationary location model that allows us to identify price bubbles. In particular, we revisit the early warning system for Alert of Price Spikes (ALPS) developed by the World Food Programme (WFP, 2014). Our model is able to correctly identify price bubbles both in-sample and out-of-sample. We show that this information can be crucially relevant for the Global Information Early Warning System of the Food and Agriculture Organization (GIEWS) of the United Nations which identifies market bubbles in prices of grains and cereals in order to manage and prevent impending food crises in developing countries.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文给出了非线性时变参数模型存在唯一平稳、遍历且φ-混合可逆解的条件，这些模型是局部非平稳或爆炸性的。这些假设与现有条件不同，因为它们不施加Lipschitz、有界增长或漂移限制。相反，我们要求时间序列包含重置动态。这些动态存在于具有突然变化的时间序列中，例如带有金融泡沫的股票价格。我们解释了我们的结果如何应用于具有时变条件均值和时变条件方差的多个模型。此外，我们通过开发一个稳健的得分驱动局部非平稳位置模型来展示局部非平稳模型的经验相关性，该模型使我们能够识别价格泡沫。特别地，我们重新审视了世界粮食计划署（WFP, 2014）开发的警报价格飙升（ALPS）早期预警系统。我们的模型能够在样本内和样本外正确识别价格泡沫。我们表明，这一信息对于联合国粮食及农业组织（GIEWS）的全球信息早期预警系统可能至关重要，该系统识别谷物和谷类价格中的市场泡沫，以便管理和预防发展中国家的迫在眉睫的粮食危机。

articles.title_en: Inference on individual treatment effects in nonseparable triangular models
articles.title_cn: 不可分离三角模型中的个体处理效应推断
articles.abstract_en: In nonseparable triangular models with a binary endogenous treatment and a binary instrumental variable, Vuong and Xu (2017) established identification results for individual treatment effects (ITEs) under the rank invariance assumption. Using their approach, Feng et al. (2019) proposed a uniformly consistent kernel estimator for the density of the ITE that utilizes estimated ITEs. In this paper, we establish the asymptotic normality of the density estimator of Feng et al. (2019) and show that the ITE estimation errors have a non-negligible effect on the asymptotic distribution of the estimator. We propose asymptotically valid standard errors that account for ITEs estimation, as well as a bias correction. Furthermore, we develop uniform confidence bands for the density of the ITE using the jackknife multiplier or nonparametric bootstrap critical values.
articles.abstract_cn: 在具有二元内生处理和二元工具变量的不可分离三角模型中，Vuong和Xu（2017）在秩不变性假设下建立了个体处理效应（ITEs）的识别结果。使用他们的方法，Feng等人（2019）提出了一种利用估计的ITEs的均匀一致核估计量来估计ITE的密度。在本文中，我们建立了Feng等人（2019）密度估计量的渐近正态性，并表明ITE估计误差对该估计量的渐近分布具有不可忽略的影响。我们提出了考虑ITEs估计的渐近有效标准误，以及偏差校正。此外，我们使用刀切乘数或非参数自助法临界值开发了ITE密度的均匀置信带。

articles.title_en: The spread of COVID-19 in London: Network effects and optimal lockdowns
articles.title_cn: COVID-19在伦敦的传播：网络效应与最优封锁
articles.abstract_en: We generalise a stochastic version of the workhorse SIR (Susceptible-Infectious-Removed) epidemiological model to account for spatial dynamics generated by network interactions. Using the London metropolitan area as a salient case study, we show that commuter network externalities account for about 42% of the propagation of COVID-19. We find that the UK lockdown measure reduced total propagation by 44%, with more than one third of the effect coming from the reduction in network externalities. Counterfactual analyses suggest that: ( i ) the lockdown was somehow late, but further delay would have had more extreme consequences; ( i i ) a targeted lockdown of a small number of highly connected geographic regions would have been equally effective, arguably with significantly lower economic costs; ( i i i ) targeted lockdowns based on threshold number of cases are not effective, since they fail to account for network externalities.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们将经典的SIR（易感-感染-移除）流行病学模型的随机版本进行推广，以考虑由网络交互产生的空间动态。以伦敦大都市区作为一个突出的案例研究，我们表明通勤网络外部性约占COVID-19传播的42%。我们发现英国的封锁措施将总传播减少了44%，其中超过三分之一的效应来自网络外部性的减少。反事实分析表明：（i）封锁在某种程度上晚了，但进一步延迟会有更极端的后果；（ii）对少数高度连接的地理区域进行针对性封锁会同样有效，可以说经济成本显著更低；（iii）基于病例数阈值的针对性封锁无效，因为它们未能考虑网络外部性。

articles.title_en: Efficient peer effects estimators with group effects
articles.title_cn: 具有组效应的有效同伴效应估计量
articles.abstract_en: We study linear peer effect models where peers interact in groups and individual’s outcomes are linear in the group mean outcome and characteristics. We allow for unobserved random group effects as well as observed fixed group effects. The specification is in part motivated by the moment conditions imposed in Graham (2008). We show that these moment conditions can be cast in terms of a linear random group effects model and that they lead to a class of GMM estimators with parameters generally identified as long as there is sufficient variation in group size or group types. We also show that our class of GMM estimators contains a Quasi Maximum Likelihood estimator (QMLE) for the random group effects model, as well as the Wald estimator of Graham (2008) and the within estimator of Lee (2007) as special cases. Our identification results extend insights in Graham (2008) that show how assumptions about random group effects, variation in group size and certain forms of heteroscedasticity can be used to overcome the reflection problem in identifying peer effects. Our QMLE and GMM estimators accommodate additional covariates and are valid in situations with a large but finite number of different group sizes or types. Because our estimators are general moment based procedures, using instruments other than binary group indicators in estimation is straight forward. Our QMLE estimator accommodates group level covariates in the spirit of Mundlak and Chamberlain and offers an alternative to fixed effects specifications. This model feature significantly extends the applicability of Graham’s identification strategy to situations where group assignment may not be random but correlation of group level effects with peer effects can be controlled for with observable group level characteristics. Monte-Carlo simulations show that the bias of the QMLE estimator decreases with the number of groups and the variation in group size, and increases with group size. We also prove the consistency and asymptotic normality of the estimator under reasonable assumptions.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究线性同伴效应模型，其中同伴在组内互动，个体的结果对组平均结果和特征呈线性关系。我们允许存在未观测的随机组效应以及观测到的固定组效应。该设定部分受到 Graham（2008）中施加的矩条件的启发。我们证明，这些矩条件可以表示为线性随机组效应模型的形式，并且它们导出一类 GMM 估计量，只要组规模或组类型有足够变异，其参数通常可识别。我们还证明，我们的 GMM 估计量类别包含随机组效应模型的拟最大似然估计量（QMLE），以及 Graham（2008）的 Wald 估计量和 Lee（2007）的组内估计量作为特例。我们的识别结果扩展了 Graham（2008）的洞见，即关于随机组效应、组规模变异和某些形式的异方差的假设如何可用于克服识别同伴效应中的反射问题。我们的 QMLE 和 GMM 估计量可容纳额外的协变量，并且在存在大量但有限数量的不同组规模或组类型的情形下有效。由于我们的估计量是一般基于矩的方法，在估计中使用二元组指示变量以外的工具变量是直接的。我们的 QMLE 估计量以 Mundlak 和 Chamberlain 的精神容纳组水平协变量，并提供了固定效应设定的替代方案。这一模型特征显著扩展了 Graham 识别策略的适用性，使其适用于组分配可能并非随机、但组水平效应与同伴效应的相关性可以通过可观测的组水平特征加以控制的情形。Monte-Carlo 模拟表明，QMLE 估计量的偏差随组数增加和组规模变异增大而减小，并随组规模增大而增大。我们还证明了该估计量在合理假设下的一致性和渐近正态性。

articles.title_en: Sparse quantile regression
articles.title_cn: 稀疏分位数回归
articles.abstract_en: We consider both ℓ 0 -penalized and ℓ 0 -constrained quantile regression estimators. For the ℓ 0 -penalized estimator, we derive an exponential inequality on the tail probability of excess quantile prediction risk and apply it to obtain non-asymptotic upper bounds on the mean-square parameter and regression function estimation errors. We also derive analogous results for the ℓ 0 -constrained estimator. The resulting rates of convergence are nearly minimax-optimal and the same as those for ℓ 1 -penalized and non-convex penalized estimators. Further, we characterize expected Hamming loss for the ℓ 0 -penalized estimator. We implement the proposed procedure via mixed integer linear programming and also a more scalable first-order approximation algorithm. We illustrate the finite-sample performance of our approach in Monte Carlo experiments and its usefulness in a real data application concerning conformal prediction of infant birth weights (with n ≈ 1 0 3 and up to p > 1 0 3 ). In sum, our ℓ 0 -based method produces a much sparser estimator than the ℓ 1 -penalized and non-convex penalized approaches without compromising precision.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们同时考虑ℓ 0惩罚和ℓ 0约束的分位数回归估计量。对于ℓ 0惩罚估计量，我们推导了超额分位数预测风险尾部概率的指数不等式，并将其应用于获得均方参数和回归函数估计误差的非渐近上界。我们还推导了ℓ 0约束估计量的类似结果。所得的收敛速度几乎是最小最大最优的，并且与ℓ 1惩罚和非凸惩罚估计量的收敛速度相同。此外，我们刻画了ℓ 0惩罚估计量的期望汉明损失。我们通过混合整数线性规划以及更具可扩展性的一阶近似算法实现所提出的方法。我们在蒙特卡洛实验中说明了我们方法的有限样本性能，及其在关于婴儿出生体重共形预测的实际数据应用中的有用性（其中n ≈ 1 0 3且高达p > 1 0 3）。总之，我们基于ℓ 0的方法产生的估计量比ℓ 1惩罚和非凸惩罚方法稀疏得多，同时不损害精度。

articles.title_en: What’s trending in difference-in-differences? A synthesis of the recent econometrics literature
articles.title_cn: 双重差分法中的趋势是什么？近期计量经济学文献的综合
articles.abstract_en: This paper synthesizes recent advances in the econometrics of difference-in-differences (DiD) and provides concrete recommendations for practitioners. We begin by articulating a simple set of “canonical” assumptions under which the econometrics of DiD are well-understood. We then argue that recent advances in DiD methods can be broadly classified as relaxing some components of the canonical DiD setup, with a focus on ( i ) multiple periods and variation in treatment timing, ( i i ) potential violations of parallel trends, or ( i i i ) alternative frameworks for inference. Our discussion highlights the different ways that the DiD literature has advanced beyond the canonical model, and helps to clarify when each of the papers will be relevant for empirical work. We conclude by discussing some promising areas for future research.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文综合了双重差分法（DiD）计量经济学的最新进展，并为实践者提供了具体建议。我们首先阐明了一组简单的“典型”假设，在这些假设下，DiD的计量经济学已被充分理解。然后我们论证，DiD方法的最新进展可以大致归类为对典型DiD设定某些组成部分的放松，重点关注（i）多个时期和处理时点的变化，（ii）平行趋势的潜在违背，或（iii）推断的替代框架。我们的讨论强调了DiD文献超越典型模型的不同方式，并有助于阐明每篇论文何时与实证工作相关。我们最后讨论了未来研究的一些有前景的领域。

articles.title_en: Semi-nonparametric estimation of random coefficients logit model for aggregate demand
articles.title_cn: 聚合需求随机系数logit模型的半非参数估计
articles.abstract_en: In this paper, we propose a two-step semi-nonparametric estimator for the widely used random coefficients logit demand model. The approach applies to the same setup as Berry et al. (1995, BLP)-type of models with many products, but has the advantage of not requiring computing demand inversion. In particular, the first step of our approach estimates the fixed coefficients via a computationally very easy linear sieve generalized method of moments (GMM). The second step uncovers the distribution of the random coefficient via a sieve minimum distance or GMM procedure. We show identification and derive the asymptotic properties of the estimator in a large market environment. Monte Carlo simulations and empirical illustrations support the theoretical results and demonstrate the usefulness of our estimator in practice.
articles.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们为广泛使用的随机系数logit需求模型提出了一种两步半非参数估计量。该方法适用于与Berry et al.（1995，BLP）类型模型相同的设定，即包含许多产品的情形，但具有无需计算需求反演的优势。特别地，我们方法的第一步通过计算上非常简便的线性筛广义矩方法（GMM）估计固定系数。第二步通过筛最小距离或GMM程序揭示随机系数的分布。我们在大市场环境下证明了识别性并推导了估计量的渐近性质。蒙特卡洛模拟和实证示例支持了理论结果，并展示了我们的估计量在实践中的有用性。

articles.title_en: Tail index estimation in the presence of covariates: Stock returns’ tail risk dynamics
articles.title_cn: 在协变量存在下的尾部指数估计：股票收益的尾部风险动态
articles.abstract_en: This paper provides novel theoretical results for the estimation of the conditional tail index of Pareto and Pareto-type distributions in a time series context. We show that both the estimators and relevant test statistics are normally distributed in the limit, when independent and identically distributed or dependent data are considered. Simulation results provide support for the theoretical findings and highlight the good finite sample properties of the approach in a time series context. The proposed methodology is then used to analyse stock returns’ tail risk dynamics. Two empirical applications are provided. The first consists in testing whether the time-varying tail exponents across firms follow Kelly and Jiang’s (2014) assumption of common firm level tail dynamics. The results obtained from our sample seem not to favour this hypothesis. The second application, consists of the evaluation of the impact of two market risk indicators, V I X and Expected Shortfall (ES) and two firm specific covariates, capitalization and market-to-book on stocks tail risk dynamics. Although all variables seem important drivers of firms’ tail risk dynamics, it is found that ES and firms’ capitalization seem to have overall wider impact.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文提供了在时间序列背景下估计Pareto和Pareto型分布的条件尾部指数的新的理论结果。我们证明，当考虑独立同分布或相依数据时，估计量和相关检验统计量在极限下均呈正态分布。模拟结果支持理论发现，并突出了该方法在时间序列背景下良好的有限样本性质。所提出的方法随后被用于分析股票收益的尾部风险动态。提供了两个实证应用。第一个应用在于检验跨公司的时变尾部指数是否遵循Kelly和Jiang（2014）关于共同公司层面尾部动态的假设。从我们的样本中获得的结果似乎不支持这一假设。第二个应用在于评估两个市场风险指标，V I X和预期短缺（ES），以及两个公司特定协变量，市值和市净率对股票尾部风险动态的影响。尽管所有变量似乎都是公司尾部风险动态的重要驱动因素，但发现ES和公司市值似乎具有总体上更广泛的影响。

articles.title_en: Reproducibility and transparency versus privacy and confidentiality: Reflections from a data editor
articles.title_cn: 可复现性与透明度对隐私与保密性：一位数据编辑的反思
articles.abstract_en: Transparency and reproducibility are often seen in opposition to privacy and confidentiality. Data that need to be kept confidential are seen as an impediment to reproducibility, and privacy would seem to inhibit transparency. I bring a more nuanced view to the discussion, and show, using examples from over 1,000 reproducibility assessments, that confidential data can very well be used in reproducible and transparent research. The key insight is that access to most confidential data, while tedious, is open to hundreds if not thousands of researchers. In cases where few researchers can consider accessing such data in the future, reproducibility services, such as those provided by some journals, can provide some evidence for effective reproducibility even when the same data may not be available for future research.
articles.abstract_cn: 透明度与可复现性常被视为与隐私和保密性相对立。需要保密的数据被视为可复现性的障碍，而隐私似乎会抑制透明度。我为这一讨论带来一种更为细致的观点，并通过来自超过 1,000 次可复现性评估的实例表明，保密数据完全可以用于可复现且透明的研究。关键洞见在于，对大多数保密数据的获取虽然繁琐，却对数百乃至数千名研究人员开放。在未来只有少数研究人员能够考虑获取此类数据的情况下，可复现性服务，例如某些期刊所提供的服务，可以为有效的可复现性提供一些证据，即使同样的数据可能无法用于未来的研究。
